

1. Importing libraries 
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)
```

2.Analysing results after STRUCTURE and CLUMPAK

2.1 Slovenia–Croatia dataset without reference populations
1a) Using only empirical data confirmed with SNP analyses

Visualisation - density plot, heatmap
```{r}
# ------------------------------------------
# CONFIGURATION
# ------------------------------------------
seeds <- 1:1
base_dir <- "ParallelStructure_Results/1a_NDinaric_empirical"

# Create R_results folder if it does not exist
dir.create(
  file.path(base_dir, "R_results"),
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# cluster order per seed (manually tune if needed)
cluster_orders <- list(
  "1" = c("Dog","N_Dinaric")
)

# colour palette for all plots

color_map <- c(
  "Dog"="#999999","Sim-Dog"="#cccccc",
  "W-Croatia" =  "blue", "W-Slovenia" =  "blue","Sim-W-Croatia"="lightblue",
  "F1"="orange", "BC1w" ="red",  "BC2w"="violet"
)

pop_levels <- c(
"Dog","Sim-Dog",
  "F1","BC1w",  "BC2w", "W-Slovenia",
  "W-Croatia"
)
# ------------------------------------------
# LOOP THROUGH SEEDS
# ------------------------------------------
for (seed in seeds) {
  cat("\n=== Seed", seed, "===\n")

  folder <- base_dir
  input_file <- file.path(folder, paste0("1a_NDinaric_empirical.txt"))
  pop_file   <- file.path(folder, paste0("1a_NDinaric_empirical_POP.txt"))
  clumpp_file <- file.path(folder, "Clumpak_results/K=2/MajorCluster/CLUMPP.files/ClumppIndFile.output")
  
  
  # --- load data
  struct_res <- read.table(clumpp_file)
  struct_input <- read.table(input_file, skip=1, as.is=TRUE)
  struct_legend <- read.table(pop_file, header=FALSE, sep=" ", as.is=TRUE)
  names(struct_legend) <- c("id","pop")

  structure_results <- cbind(struct_input[,1:2], struct_res[,6:7])
  structure_results$V2 <- as.character(structure_results$V2)
  names(structure_results) <- c("Sample","Pop", cluster_orders[[as.character(seed)]])
  structure_results$Pop <- as.character(structure_results$Pop)
struct_legend$id <- as.character(struct_legend$id)


structure_results <- left_join(structure_results, struct_legend, by = c("Pop" = "id"))

  # ------------------------------------------------
  # FORCE POP ORDER FOR LEGEND 
  # ------------------------------------------------
 structure_results$pop <- factor(
    structure_results$pop,
    levels = pop_levels
  )

  # --- compute reference means and thresholds
  ref_means <- structure_results %>%
    filter(pop %in% c("Dog","Sim-Dog",
                       "F1","BC1w",   "BC2w", "W-Slovenia",
                      "W-Croatia", "Sim-W-Croatia"))
   thresholds_adj <- c(
  BC2d  = 0.94,
  BC1d  = 0.83,
  F1    = 0.64,
  BC1w  = 0.32,
  BC2w  = 0.12,
  Wolf  = 0.05)
  

  thresh_BC2d <- thresholds_adj["BC2d"]
  thresh_BC1d <- thresholds_adj["BC1d"]
  thresh_BC2w <- thresholds_adj["BC2w"]
  thresh_BC1w <- thresholds_adj["BC1w"]
  thresh_F1   <- thresholds_adj["F1"]
  thresh_wolf   <- thresholds_adj["Wolf"]

  # --- classify samples
structure_results_categories <- structure_results %>%
  mutate(across(c(Dog, N_Dinaric), as.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(
    hy_verdict = case_when(
      Dog >= thresh_BC2d        ~ "Dog",
      Dog >= thresh_BC1d        ~ "BC2d",
      Dog >= thresh_F1          ~ "BC1d",
      Dog >= thresh_BC1w        ~ "F1",
      Dog >= thresh_BC2w        ~ "BC1w",
      Dog >= thresh_wolf        ~ "BC2w",
      TRUE                      ~ "Wolf"
  ))

  # ------------------------------------------
  # PLOT 1: DENSITY PLOT
  # ------------------------------------------
  thresholds_df <- data.frame(
  value = c(
    thresh_wolf,
    thresh_BC2w,
    thresh_BC1w,
    thresh_F1,
    thresh_BC1d,
    thresh_BC2d
  ),
  label = c(
    paste0("wolf < ", round(thresh_wolf, 3), " > BC2w"),
    paste0("BC2w < ", round(thresh_BC2w, 3), " > BC1w"),
    paste0("BC1w < ", round(thresh_BC1w, 3), " > F1"),
    paste0("F1 < ", round(thresh_F1, 3), " > BC1d"),
    paste0("BC1d < ", round(thresh_BC1d, 3), " > BC2d"),
    paste0("BC2d < ", round(thresh_BC2d, 3), " > dog")
  )
)
  p_density <- structure_results %>%
    filter(pop %in% names(color_map)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=Dog, fill=pop)) +
    geom_density(alpha=0.5, adjust=1) +
    geom_vline(data=thresholds_df, aes(xintercept=value),
               linetype="dashed", color="red", linewidth=0.6) +
    geom_text(data=thresholds_df, aes(x=value, y=45, label=label),
              inherit.aes=FALSE, angle=90, vjust=-0.4, size=3, color="red") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,50)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=color_map) +
    theme(legend.position="right", legend.title=element_blank()) +
    labs(title=paste("Distribution of dog Q-values"),
         subtitle="Dashed red lines show hybrid thresholds",
         x="Q_Dog value", y="Density (capped at 50)")

  ggsave(file.path(base_dir, paste0("R_results/1a_NDinaric_empirical_density_plot.png")),
         p_density, width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

# ------------------------------------------
# PLOT 2: HEATMAP OF POP VS. HYBRID CLASS
# ------------------------------------------
table_data_plot <- table(structure_results_categories$pop,
                         structure_results_categories$hy_verdict)
categories_plot <- as.data.frame(table_data_plot)
names(categories_plot) <- c("pop","hy_verdict","count")

# fixed order for populations and hybrid classes


hy_levels <- c(
  "Dog", "BC2d","BC1d", "F1", "BC1w", "BC2w",
 "Wolf"
)

# apply factor levels for consistent order across all seeds
categories_plot$pop <- factor(categories_plot$pop, levels = pop_levels)
categories_plot$hy_verdict <- factor(categories_plot$hy_verdict, levels = hy_levels)

p_heatmap <- ggplot(categories_plot, aes(x = pop, y = hy_verdict, fill = count)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = count), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
  colours = c("white", "#deebf7", "#6baed6", "#2171b5"),
  values = scales::rescale(c(0, 3, max(categories_plot$count) * 0.5, max(categories_plot$count))))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 8),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")) +
  labs(title = paste("STRUCTURE assignment results vs. actual group"),
       x = "Actual group",
       y = "STRUCTURE assignment results")

ggsave(file.path(base_dir, paste0("R_results/1a_NDinaric_empirical_heatmap.png")),
       p_heatmap, width = 11, height = 6, dpi = 300)

}

```


Statistics - Hybrid classification accuracy
```{r}
# =====================================================
# SETTINGS
# =====================================================

seeds <- 1:1
base_dir <- "ParallelStructure_Results/1a_NDinaric_empirical"

# cluster order per seed (manually tune if needed)
cluster_orders <- list(
  "1" = c("Dog", "N_Dinaric")
)

pop_levels <- c(
  "Dog","Sim-Dog",
  "F1","BC1w","BC2w","W-Slovenia",
  "W-Croatia","Sim-W-Croatia"
)

wolf_classes <- c("W-Croatia","W-Slovenia")

expected_cols <- c(
  "Dog","BC2d","BC1d","F1","BC1w","BC2w","Wolf"
)

# =====================================================
# 1️⃣ LOAD AND CLASSIFY (SINGLE SEED)
# =====================================================

all_results <- list()

for (seed in seeds) {

  cat("\n=== Seed", seed, "===\n")

  folder <- base_dir

  input_file <- file.path(folder, paste0("1a_NDinaric_empirical.txt"))
  pop_file   <- file.path(folder, paste0("1a_NDinaric_empirical_POP.txt"))
  clumpp_file <- file.path(folder, "Clumpak_results/K=2/MajorCluster/CLUMPP.files/ClumppIndFile.output")

  # --- load files
  struct_res    <- read.table(clumpp_file)
  struct_input  <- read.table(input_file, skip = 1, as.is = TRUE)
  struct_legend <- read.table(pop_file, header = FALSE, sep = " ", as.is = TRUE)
  names(struct_legend) <- c("id","pop")

  structure_results <- cbind(struct_input[,1:2], struct_res[,6:7])
  names(structure_results) <- c("Sample","Pop", cluster_orders[[as.character(seed)]])
  structure_results$Pop <- as.character(structure_results$Pop)
  struct_legend$id <- as.character(struct_legend$id)

  structure_results <- left_join(
    structure_results,
    struct_legend,
    by = c("Pop" = "id")
  )

  # =====================================================
  # THRESHOLDS
  # =====================================================

  thresholds_adj <- c(
    BC2d  = 0.94,
    BC1d  = 0.83,
    F1    = 0.64,
    BC1w   = 0.32,
    BC2w  = 0.12,
    Wolf  = 0.05
  )

  thresh_BC2d  <- thresholds_adj["BC2d"]
  thresh_BC1d  <- thresholds_adj["BC1d"]
  thresh_F1    <- thresholds_adj["F1"]
  thresh_BC1w   <- thresholds_adj["BC1w"]
  thresh_BC2w  <- thresholds_adj["BC2w"]
  thresh_wolf  <- thresholds_adj["Wolf"]

  # =====================================================
  # CLASSIFICATION
  # =====================================================

  structure_results_categories <- structure_results %>%
    mutate(across(c(Dog, N_Dinaric), as.numeric)) %>%
    mutate(
      hy_verdict = case_when(
        Dog >= thresh_BC2d ~ "Dog",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1d ~ "BC2d",
        Dog >= thresh_F1   ~ "BC1d",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1w  ~ "F1",
        Dog >= thresh_BC2w ~ "BC1w",
        Dog >= thresh_wolf ~ "BC2w",
        TRUE               ~ "Wolf"
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(seed = seed) %>%
    select(Sample, pop, Dog, hy_verdict, seed)

  all_results[[as.character(seed)]] <- structure_results_categories
}

# =====================================================
# 2️⃣ COMBINE (ONLY 1 SEED, BUT SAME STRUCTURE)
# =====================================================

all_classifications <- bind_rows(all_results)

performance_summary <- all_classifications %>%
  mutate(
    classified_group = case_when(
      hy_verdict %in% wolf_classes ~ "Wolf",
      TRUE ~ hy_verdict
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(pop, classified_group) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(pop) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(count),
    percentage = 100 * count / total
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, percentage) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = percentage,
    values_fill = 0
  )

# Ensure all expected columns exist
missing_cols <- setdiff(expected_cols, names(performance_summary))
for (col in missing_cols) {
  performance_summary[[col]] <- 0
}

# Apply population order
performance_summary <- performance_summary %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop) %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols))

# =====================================================
# 3️⃣ EXPORT (MATCHING YOUR MEAN SCRIPT STYLE)
# =====================================================

output_file <- file.path(
  base_dir,
  "R_results/1a_Hybrid_classification_accuracy.xlsx"
)

wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, "Classification_percentages")
writeData(wb, "Classification_percentages", performance_summary)

saveWorkbook(wb, output_file, overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r}
structure_results <- left_join(structure_results, struct_legend, by = c("Pop" = "id"))

   thresholds_adj <- c(

  thresh_BC2d <- thresholds_adj["BC2d"]

  thresh_BC2w <- thresholds_adj["BC2w"]
  thresh_BC1w <- thresholds_adj["BC1w"]
  thresh_F1   <- thresholds_adj["F1"]
  thresh_wolf   <- thresholds_adj["Wolf"]

  # --- classify samples
structure_results_categories <- structure_results %>%
  mutate(across(c(Dog, N_Dinaric), as.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(
```

Statistics - Hybrid classification accuracy
```{r}


seeds <- 1:1
base_dir <- "ParallelStructure_Results/1b_NDinaric_empirical_all_dogs"

# cluster order per seed (manually tune if needed)
cluster_orders <- list(
  "1" = c("Dog","N_Dinaric")
)

pop_levels <- c(
"Dog","Sim-Dog",
 "F1", "BC1w",  "BC2w","W-Slovenia",
  "W-Croatia", "Sim-W-Croatia"                                        
)

wolf_classes <- c("W-Croatia", "W-Slovenia")
expected_cols <- c(  "Dog", "BC2d","BC1d", "F1", "BC1w", "BC2w", "Wolf")

# =====================================================
# 1️⃣ LOAD ALL SEEDS AND CLASSIFY
# =====================================================
all_results <- list()

# ------------------------------------------
# LOOP THROUGH SEEDS
# ------------------------------------------
for (seed in seeds) {
  cat("\n=== Seed", seed, "===\n")

  folder <- base_dir
  input_file <- file.path(folder, paste0("1b_NDinaric_empirical_all_dogs.txt"))
  pop_file   <- file.path(folder, paste0("1b_NDinaric_empirical_all_dogs_POP.txt"))
  clumpp_file <- file.path(folder, "Clumpak_results/K=2/MajorCluster/CLUMPP.files/ClumppIndFile.output")
  
  # --- load data
  struct_res <- read.table(clumpp_file)
  struct_input <- read.table(input_file, skip=1, as.is=TRUE)
  struct_legend <- read.table(pop_file, header=FALSE, sep=" ", as.is=TRUE)
  names(struct_legend) <- c("id","pop")

  structure_results <- cbind(struct_input[,1:2], struct_res[,6:7])
  structure_results$V2 <- as.character(structure_results$V2)
  names(structure_results) <- c("Sample","Pop", cluster_orders[[as.character(seed)]])
  structure_results$Pop <- as.character(structure_results$Pop)
struct_legend$id <- as.character(struct_legend$id)

structure_results <- left_join(structure_results, struct_legend, by = c("Pop" = "id"))


  # =====================================================
  # THRESHOLDS
  # =====================================================

  thresholds_adj <- c(
    BC2d  = 0.94,
    BC1d  = 0.83,
    F1    = 0.64,
    BC1w  = 0.32,
    BC2w  = 0.12,
    Wolf  = 0.05
  )

  thresh_BC2d  <- thresholds_adj["BC2d"]
  thresh_BC1d  <- thresholds_adj["BC1d"]
  thresh_F1    <- thresholds_adj["F1"]
  thresh_BC1w   <- thresholds_adj["BC1w"]
  thresh_BC2w  <- thresholds_adj["BC2w"]
  thresh_wolf  <- thresholds_adj["Wolf"]

  # =====================================================
  # CLASSIFICATION
  # =====================================================

  structure_results_categories <- structure_results %>%
    mutate(across(c(Dog, N_Dinaric), as.numeric)) %>%
    mutate(
      hy_verdict = case_when(
        Dog >= thresh_BC2d ~ "Dog",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1d ~ "BC2d",
        Dog >= thresh_F1   ~ "BC1d",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1w  ~ "F1",
        Dog >= thresh_BC2w ~ "BC1w",
        Dog >= thresh_wolf ~ "BC2w",
        TRUE               ~ "Wolf"
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(seed = seed) %>%
    select(Sample, pop, Dog, hy_verdict, seed)

  all_results[[as.character(seed)]] <- structure_results_categories
}

# =====================================================
# 2️⃣ COMBINE (ONLY 1 SEED, BUT SAME STRUCTURE)
# =====================================================

all_classifications <- bind_rows(all_results)

performance_summary <- all_classifications %>%
  mutate(
    classified_group = case_when(
      hy_verdict %in% wolf_classes ~ "Wolf",
      TRUE ~ hy_verdict
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(pop, classified_group) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(pop) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(count),
    percentage = 100 * count / total
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, percentage) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = percentage,
    values_fill = 0
  )

# Ensure all expected columns exist
missing_cols <- setdiff(expected_cols, names(performance_summary))
for (col in missing_cols) {
  performance_summary[[col]] <- 0
}

# Apply population order
performance_summary <- performance_summary %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop) %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols))

# =====================================================
# 3️⃣ EXPORT (MATCHING YOUR MEAN SCRIPT STYLE)
# =====================================================

output_file <- file.path(
  base_dir,
  "R_results/1b_Hybrid_classification_accuracy.xlsx"
)

wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, "Classification_percentages")
writeData(wb, "Classification_percentages", performance_summary)

saveWorkbook(wb, output_file, overwrite = TRUE)
```

1c) Simulations of dog samples added to balance the numbers

Visualisation - density plot, heatmap
```{r}
# ------------------------------------------
# CONFIGURATION
# ------------------------------------------
seeds <- 1:10
base_dir <- "ParallelStructure_Results/1c_NDinaric_empirical_Sim_dog"

# Create R_results folder if it does not exist
dir.create(
  file.path(base_dir, "R_results"),
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# cluster order per seed (manually tune if needed)
cluster_orders <- list(
  "1" = c("Dog","N_Dinaric"),
  "2" = c("Dog","N_Dinaric"),
  "3" = c("Dog","N_Dinaric"),
  "4" = c("Dog","N_Dinaric"),
  "5" = c("Dog","N_Dinaric"),
  "6" = c("Dog","N_Dinaric"),
  "7" = c("Dog","N_Dinaric"),
  "8" = c("Dog","N_Dinaric"),
  "9" = c("Dog","N_Dinaric"),
  "10" = c("Dog","N_Dinaric")
)


color_map <- c(
  "Dog"="#999999","Sim-dog"="#cccccc",
  "W-Croatia" =  "blue", "W-Slovenia" =  "blue","Sim-W-Croatia"="lightblue",
  "F1"="orange", "BC1w" ="red",  "BC2w"="violet"
)

pop_levels <- c(
"Dog","Sim-dog",
  "F1","BC1w",  "BC2w", "W-Slovenia",
  "W-Croatia"
)


# ------------------------------------------
# LOOP THROUGH SEEDS
# ------------------------------------------
for (seed in seeds) {
  cat("\n=== Seed", seed, "===\n")

  folder <- file.path(base_dir, paste0("1c_NDinaric_empirical_Sim_dog_", seed))
  input_file <- file.path(folder, paste0("1c_NDinaric_empirical_Sim_dog_", seed, ".txt"))
  pop_file   <- file.path(folder, paste0("1c_NDinaric_empirical_Sim_dog_", seed, "_POP.txt"))
  clumpp_file <- file.path(folder, "Clumpak_results/K=2/MajorCluster/CLUMPP.files/ClumppIndFile.output")
  
  # --- load data
  struct_res <- read.table(clumpp_file)
  struct_input <- read.table(input_file, skip=1, as.is=TRUE)
  struct_legend <- read.table(pop_file, header=FALSE, sep=" ", as.is=TRUE)
  names(struct_legend) <- c("id","pop")

  structure_results <- cbind(struct_input[,1:2], struct_res[,6:7])
  structure_results$V2 <- as.character(structure_results$V2)
  names(structure_results) <- c("Sample","Pop", cluster_orders[[as.character(seed)]])
  structure_results$Pop <- as.character(structure_results$Pop)
struct_legend$id <- as.character(struct_legend$id)


structure_results <- left_join(structure_results, struct_legend, by = c("Pop" = "id"))

  # ------------------------------------------------
  # FORCE POP ORDER FOR LEGEND 
  # ------------------------------------------------
 structure_results$pop <- factor(
    structure_results$pop,
    levels = pop_levels
  )
  # --- compute reference means and thresholds
  ref_means <- structure_results %>%
    filter(pop %in% c("Dog","Sim-dog",
                       "F1","BC1w",   "BC2w", "W-Slovenia",
                      "W-Croatia", "Sim-W-Croatia"))
thresholds_adj <- c(
  BC2d  = 0.94,
  BC1d  = 0.83,
  F1    = 0.64,
  BC1w  = 0.32,
  BC2w  = 0.12,
  Wolf  = 0.05)
  

  thresh_BC2d <- thresholds_adj["BC2d"]
  thresh_BC1d <- thresholds_adj["BC1d"]
  thresh_BC2w <- thresholds_adj["BC2w"]
  thresh_BC1w <- thresholds_adj["BC1w"]
  thresh_F1   <- thresholds_adj["F1"]
  thresh_wolf   <- thresholds_adj["Wolf"]

  # --- classify samples
structure_results_categories <- structure_results %>%
  mutate(across(c(Dog, N_Dinaric), as.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(
    hy_verdict = case_when(
      Dog >= thresh_BC2d        ~ "Dog",
      Dog >= thresh_BC1d        ~ "BC2d",
      Dog >= thresh_F1          ~ "BC1d",
      Dog >= thresh_BC1w         ~ "F1",
      Dog >= thresh_BC2w        ~ "BC1w",
      Dog >= thresh_wolf        ~ "BC2w",
      TRUE                      ~ "Wolf"
  ))

  # ------------------------------------------
  # PLOT 1: DENSITY PLOT
  # ------------------------------------------
  thresholds_df <- data.frame(
  value = c(
    thresh_wolf,
    thresh_BC2w,
    thresh_BC1w,
    thresh_F1,
    thresh_BC1d,
    thresh_BC2d
  ),
  label = c(
    paste0("wolf < ", round(thresh_wolf, 3), " > BC2w"),
    paste0("BC2w < ", round(thresh_BC2w, 3), " > BC1w"),
    paste0("BC1w < ", round(thresh_BC1w, 3), " > F1"),
    paste0("F1 < ", round(thresh_F1, 3), " > BC1d"),
    paste0("BC1d < ", round(thresh_BC1d, 3), " > BC2d"),
    paste0("BC2d < ", round(thresh_BC2d, 3), " > dog")
  )
)
  p_density <- structure_results %>%
    filter(pop %in% names(color_map)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=Dog, fill=pop)) +
    geom_density(alpha=0.5, adjust=1) +
    geom_vline(data=thresholds_df, aes(xintercept=value),
               linetype="dashed", color="red", linewidth=0.6) +
    geom_text(data=thresholds_df, aes(x=value, y=45, label=label),
              inherit.aes=FALSE, angle=90, vjust=-0.4, size=3, color="red") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,50)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=color_map) +
    theme(legend.position="right", legend.title=element_blank()) +
    labs(title=paste("Distribution of dog Q-values – simulation replicate", seed),
         subtitle="Dashed red lines show hybrid thresholds",
         x="Q_Dog value", y="Density (capped at 50)")

  ggsave(file.path(base_dir, paste0("R_results/1c_NDinaric_empirical_Sim_dog_",seed,"_density_plot.png")),
         p_density, width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

# ------------------------------------------
# PLOT 2: HEATMAP OF POP VS. HYBRID CLASS
# ------------------------------------------
table_data_plot <- table(structure_results_categories$pop,
                         structure_results_categories$hy_verdict)
categories_plot <- as.data.frame(table_data_plot)
names(categories_plot) <- c("pop","hy_verdict","count")

# fixed order for populations and hybrid classes

hy_levels <- c(
  "Dog", "BC2d","BC1d", "F1", "BC1w", "BC2w",
 "Wolf"
)

# apply factor levels for consistent order across all seeds
categories_plot$pop <- factor(categories_plot$pop, levels = pop_levels)
categories_plot$hy_verdict <- factor(categories_plot$hy_verdict, levels = hy_levels)

p_heatmap <- ggplot(categories_plot, aes(x = pop, y = hy_verdict, fill = count)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = count), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
  colours = c("white", "#deebf7", "#6baed6", "#2171b5"),
  values = scales::rescale(c(0, 3, max(categories_plot$count) * 0.5, max(categories_plot$count))))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 8),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")) +
  labs(title = paste("STRUCTURE assignment results vs. actual group – simulation replicate", seed),
       x = "Actual group",
       y = "STRUCTURE assignment results")




ggsave(file.path(base_dir, paste0("R_results/1c_NDinaric_empirical_Sim_dog_", seed, "_heatmap.png")),
       p_heatmap, width = 11, height = 6, dpi = 300)
}
```

Statistics - Hybrid classification accuracy
```{r}
# =====================================================
# SETTINGS
# =====================================================

seeds <- 1:10
base_dir <- "ParallelStructure_Results/1c_NDinaric_empirical_Sim_dog"

# cluster order per seed (manually tune if needed)
cluster_orders <- list(
  "1" = c("Dog","N_Dinaric"),
  "2" = c("Dog","N_Dinaric"),
  "3" = c("Dog","N_Dinaric"),
  "4" = c("Dog","N_Dinaric"),
  "5" = c("Dog","N_Dinaric"),
  "6" = c("Dog","N_Dinaric"),
  "7" = c("Dog","N_Dinaric"),
  "8" = c("Dog","N_Dinaric"),
  "9" = c("Dog","N_Dinaric"),
  "10" = c("Dog","N_Dinaric")
)


pop_levels <- c(
"Dog","Sim-dog",
  "F1", "BC1w","BC2w",
   "W-Slovenia", "W-Croatia"
)


wolf_classes <- c("N_Dinaric")
expected_cols <- c("Dog","BC2d","BC1d","F1","BC1w","BC2w","Wolf")

# =====================================================
# 1️⃣ LOAD + CLASSIFY ALL SEEDS
# =====================================================

all_results <- list()

for (seed in seeds) {

  folder <- file.path(base_dir, paste0("1c_NDinaric_empirical_Sim_dog_", seed))
  input_file <- file.path(folder, paste0("1c_NDinaric_empirical_Sim_dog_", seed, ".txt"))
  pop_file   <- file.path(folder, paste0("1c_NDinaric_empirical_Sim_dog_", seed, "_POP.txt"))
  clumpp_file <- file.path(folder, "Clumpak_results/K=2/MajorCluster/CLUMPP.files/ClumppIndFile.output")

  struct_res    <- read.table(clumpp_file)
  struct_input  <- read.table(input_file, skip = 1, as.is = TRUE)
  struct_legend <- read.table(pop_file, header = FALSE, sep = " ", as.is = TRUE)
  names(struct_legend) <- c("id","pop")

  structure_results <- cbind(struct_input[,1:2], struct_res[,6:7])
  names(structure_results) <- c("Sample","Pop", cluster_orders[[as.character(seed)]])
  structure_results$Pop <- as.character(structure_results$Pop)
  struct_legend$id <- as.character(struct_legend$id)

  structure_results <- left_join(structure_results, struct_legend,
                                 by = c("Pop" = "id"))

  structure_results$pop <- factor(structure_results$pop, levels = pop_levels)

  # =====================================================
  # THRESHOLDS 
  # =====================================================
  
  ref_means <- structure_results %>%
    group_by(pop) %>%
    summarise(mean_qDog = mean(as.numeric(Dog), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

thresholds_adj <- c(
  BC2d  = 0.94,
  BC1d  = 0.83,
  F1    = 0.64,
  BC1w   = 0.32,
  BC2w  = 0.12,
  Wolf  = 0.05)
  
  

  thresh_BC2d <- thresholds_adj["BC2d"]
  thresh_BC1d <- thresholds_adj["BC1d"]
  thresh_BC2w <- thresholds_adj["BC2w"]
  thresh_BC1w <- thresholds_adj["BC1w"]
  thresh_F1   <- thresholds_adj["F1"]
  thresh_wolf   <- thresholds_adj["Wolf"]

  classified <- structure_results %>%
    mutate(across(c(Dog,N_Dinaric), as.numeric)) %>%
    mutate(
      hy_verdict = case_when(
        Dog >= thresh_BC2d ~ "Dog",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1d ~ "BC2d",
        Dog >= thresh_F1   ~ "BC1d",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1w  ~ "F1",
        Dog >= thresh_BC2w ~ "BC1w",
        Dog >= thresh_wolf ~ "BC2w",
        TRUE ~ "N_Dinaric"
      ),
      seed = seed
    ) %>%
    select(pop, hy_verdict, seed)

  all_results[[as.character(seed)]] <- classified
}

all_classifications <- bind_rows(all_results)

# =====================================================
# 2️⃣ CALCULATE % PER SEED
# =====================================================

seed_counts <- all_classifications %>%
  mutate(
    pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels),
    classified_group = ifelse(hy_verdict %in% wolf_classes, "Wolf", hy_verdict)
  ) %>%
  count(seed, pop, classified_group) %>%
  complete(seed, pop = pop_levels, classified_group = expected_cols, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  group_by(seed, pop) %>%
  mutate(percentage = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

# =====================================================
# 3️⃣ PER-SEED TABLES
# =====================================================

seed_tables <- seed_counts %>%
  select(seed, pop, classified_group, percentage) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group,
              values_from = percentage,
              values_fill = 0)

# =====================================================
# 4️⃣ MEAN + SD + SE + CI (FROM CODE 3)
# =====================================================

summary_stats <- seed_counts %>%
  group_by(pop, classified_group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(percentage),
    sd   = sd(percentage),
    n    = n(),
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    ci_lower = mean - qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se,
    ci_upper = mean + qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- mean only
mean_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group, values_from = mean, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop) %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols))

# --- mean ± SD
mean_sd_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, sd) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group, values_from = c(mean, sd))

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_sd_table[[cls]] <- sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f",
                                  mean_sd_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
                                  mean_sd_table[[paste0("sd_", cls)]])
}

mean_sd_table <- mean_sd_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)

# --- mean ± SE
mean_se_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, se) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group, values_from = c(mean, se))

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_se_table[[cls]] <- sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f",
                                  mean_se_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
                                  mean_se_table[[paste0("se_", cls)]])
}

mean_se_table <- mean_se_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)

# --- mean ± CI
mean_ci_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, ci_lower, ci_upper) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group,
              values_from = c(mean, ci_lower, ci_upper))

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_ci_table[[cls]] <- sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)",
                                  mean_ci_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
                                  mean_ci_table[[paste0("ci_lower_", cls)]],
                                  mean_ci_table[[paste0("ci_upper_", cls)]])
}

mean_ci_table <- mean_ci_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)

# =====================================================
# 5️⃣ EXPORT
# =====================================================

wb <- createWorkbook()

for (s in seeds) {
  seed_sheet <- seed_tables %>%
    filter(seed == s) %>%
    mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
    arrange(pop) %>%
    select(pop, all_of(expected_cols))

  addWorksheet(wb, paste0("Seed_", s))
  writeData(wb, paste0("Seed_", s), seed_sheet)
}

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_only")
writeData(wb, "Mean_only", mean_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_plus_SD")
writeData(wb, "Mean_plus_SD", mean_sd_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_plus_SE")
writeData(wb, "Mean_plus_SE", mean_se_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_plus_CI")
writeData(wb, "Mean_plus_CI", mean_ci_table)

saveWorkbook(
  wb,
  "ParallelStructure_Results/1c_NDinaric_empirical_Sim_dog/R_results/1c_K2_Hybrid_classification_accuracy_per_seed_1-10_SD_SE_CI.xlsx",
  overwrite = TRUE
)
```

Classification and Q_Dog value for empirical hybrids and problematic wolves
```{r}

# =====================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# =====================================================
seeds <- 1:10
base_dir <- "ParallelStructure_Results/1c_NDinaric_empirical_Sim_dog"

# cluster order per seed (manually tune if needed)
cluster_orders <- list(
  "1" = c("Dog","N_Dinaric"),
  "2" = c("Dog","N_Dinaric"),
  "3" = c("Dog","N_Dinaric"),
  "4" = c("Dog","N_Dinaric"),
  "5" = c("Dog","N_Dinaric"),
  "6" = c("Dog","N_Dinaric"),
  "7" = c("Dog","N_Dinaric"),
  "8" = c("Dog","N_Dinaric"),
  "9" = c("Dog","N_Dinaric"),
  "10" = c("Dog","N_Dinaric")
)
hybrid_labels <- c("BC2d","BC1d","F1","BC1w","BC2w")

# =====================================================
# 1️⃣ LOAD + CLASSIFY ALL SEEDS
# =====================================================
all_results <- list()

for (seed in seeds) {

  folder <- file.path(base_dir, paste0("1c_NDinaric_empirical_Sim_dog_", seed))
  input_file  <- file.path(folder, paste0("1c_NDinaric_empirical_Sim_dog_", seed, ".txt"))
  pop_file    <- file.path(folder, paste0("1c_NDinaric_empirical_Sim_dog_", seed, "_POP.txt"))
  clumpp_file <- file.path(folder, "Clumpak_results/K=2/MajorCluster/CLUMPP.files/ClumppIndFile.output")

  struct_res    <- read.table(clumpp_file)
  struct_input  <- read.table(input_file, skip = 1, as.is = TRUE)
  struct_legend <- read.table(pop_file, header = FALSE, as.is = TRUE)
  names(struct_legend) <- c("id","pop")

  structure_results <- cbind(struct_input[,1:2], struct_res[,6:7])
  names(structure_results) <- c("Sample","Pop", cluster_orders[[as.character(seed)]])
  structure_results$Pop <- as.character(structure_results$Pop)
  struct_legend$id <- as.character(struct_legend$id)

  structure_results <- left_join(structure_results, struct_legend, by = c("Pop" = "id"))


  # ---- reference means (UNCHANGED)
  ref_means <- structure_results %>%
    filter(pop %in% c("Dog","Sim-Dog",
                     "F1", "BC1w","BC2w", 
                      "W-Slovenia","W-Croatia")) %>%
    group_by(pop) %>%
    summarise(mean_qDog = mean(Dog, na.rm = TRUE), .groups="drop")

 thresholds_adj <- c(
  BC2d  = 0.94,
  BC1d  = 0.83,
  F1    = 0.64,
  BC1w   = 0.32,
  BC2w  = 0.12,
  Wolf  = 0.05)
  
  

  thresh_BC2d <- thresholds_adj["BC2d"]
  thresh_BC1d <- thresholds_adj["BC1d"]
  thresh_BC2w <- thresholds_adj["BC2w"]
  thresh_BC1w <- thresholds_adj["BC1w"]
  thresh_F1   <- thresholds_adj["F1"]
  thresh_wolf   <- thresholds_adj["Wolf"]

  structure_results <- structure_results %>%
    mutate(across(c(Dog, N_Dinaric), as.numeric)) %>%
    mutate(
            hy_verdict = case_when(
        Dog >= thresh_BC2d ~ "Dog",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1d ~ "BC2d",
        Dog >= thresh_F1   ~ "BC1d",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1w  ~ "F1",
        Dog >= thresh_BC2w ~ "BC1w",
        Dog >= thresh_wolf ~ "BC2w",
        TRUE ~ "N_Dinaric"
      ),
      seed = seed
    ) %>%
    select(Sample, pop, Dog, hy_verdict, seed)

  all_results[[as.character(seed)]] <- structure_results
}

all_classifications <- bind_rows(all_results)

# =====================================================
# 2️⃣ FILTER: EMPIRICAL ONLY, NO DOGS
# =====================================================
all_classifications_empirical <- all_classifications %>%
  filter(
    !grepl("^Sim-", pop),   # remove simulated samples
    pop != "Dog"            # remove dogs
  )

# =====================================================
# 3️⃣ SELECT ALL HYBRIDS + ONLY WOLVES EVER HYBRID
# =====================================================
samples_of_interest <- all_classifications_empirical %>%
  mutate(is_hybrid = hy_verdict %in% hybrid_labels) %>%
  group_by(Sample, pop) %>%
  summarise(ever_hybrid = any(is_hybrid), .groups="drop") %>%
  filter(!(pop %in% c("W-Slovenia","W-Croatia")) | ever_hybrid)

# =====================================================
# 4️⃣ PIVOT STRUCTURE assignment resultS (10 seeds)
# =====================================================
verdict_wide <- all_classifications_empirical %>%
  semi_join(samples_of_interest, by = c("Sample","pop")) %>%
  select(Sample, pop, seed, hy_verdict) %>%
  mutate(seed = paste0("Seed", seed, "_class")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = seed, values_from = hy_verdict)

# =====================================================
# 5️⃣ PIVOT Q_Dog valueS (10 seeds)
# =====================================================
qdog_wide <- all_classifications_empirical %>%
  semi_join(samples_of_interest, by = c("Sample","pop")) %>%
  select(Sample, pop, seed, Dog) %>%
  mutate(seed = paste0("Seed", seed, "_qDog")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = seed, values_from = Dog)

# =====================================================
# 6️⃣ FINAL 22-COLUMN TABLE
# =====================================================
final_hybrid_table <- verdict_wide %>%
  left_join(qdog_wide, by = c("Sample","pop")) %>%
  rename(
    SampleID = Sample,
    Population = pop
  ) %>%
  arrange(Population, SampleID)

# =====================================================
# 6b️⃣ COUNT CLASSIFICATIONS ACROSS SEEDS (FIXED)
# =====================================================

# Identify class columns
class_cols <- grep("_class$", names(final_hybrid_table), value = TRUE)

# Convert to long format
class_long <- final_hybrid_table %>%
  select(SampleID, Population, all_of(class_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(class_cols),
    names_to = "Seed",
    values_to = "Class"
  )

# Count classifications per sample
class_counts <- class_long %>%
  group_by(SampleID, Population, Class) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Pivot back to wide format
class_counts_wide <- class_counts %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Class,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0,
    names_prefix = "n_"
  )

# -----------------------------------------------------
# Combine all wolf-type assignments into one column
# -----------------------------------------------------

wolf_categories <- c(
  "W-Slovenia", "W-Croatia"
)

# -----------------------------------------------------
# Join back to main table
# -----------------------------------------------------

final_hybrid_table <- final_hybrid_table %>%
  left_join(class_counts_wide, by = c("SampleID","Population"))
# =====================================================
# 7️⃣ EXPORT
# =====================================================
write.xlsx(
  final_hybrid_table,
  "ParallelStructure_Results/1c_NDinaric_empirical_Sim_dog/R_results/Empirical_hybrids_and_problematic_wolves_all_seeds_1c.xlsx",
  rowNames = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
 "Sim-BC2d_CRO", "Sim-BC1d_CRO", "F1","Sim-F1_CRO", "BC1w", "Sim-BC1w_CRO",  "BC2w","Sim-BC2w_CRO",
  "W-Croatia"
)

# ------------------------------------------
# LOOP THROUGH SEEDS
# ------------------------------------------
for (seed in seeds) {
  cat("\n=== Seed", seed, "===\n")

  folder <- file.path(base_dir, paste0("2ai_Croatia_low_numbers_", seed))
  input_file <- file.path(folder, paste0("2ai_Croatia_low_numbers_", seed, ".txt"))
  pop_file   <- file.path(folder, paste0("2ai_Croatia_low_numbers_", seed, "_POP.txt"))
  clumpp_file <- file.path(folder, "Clumpak_results/K=2/MajorCluster/CLUMPP.files/ClumppIndFile.output")
  
  
  # --- load data
  struct_res <- read.table(clumpp_file)
  struct_input <- read.table(input_file, skip=1, as.is=TRUE)
  struct_legend <- read.table(pop_file, header=FALSE, sep=" ", as.is=TRUE)
  names(struct_legend) <- c("id","pop")

  structure_results <- cbind(struct_input[,1:2], struct_res[,6:7])
  structure_results$V2 <- as.character(structure_results$V2)
  names(structure_results) <- c("Sample","Pop", cluster_orders[[as.character(seed)]])
  structure_results$Pop <- as.character(structure_results$Pop)
struct_legend$id <- as.character(struct_legend$id)


structure_results <- left_join(structure_results, struct_legend, by = c("Pop" = "id"))

  # ------------------------------------------------
  # FORCE POP ORDER FOR LEGEND 
  # ------------------------------------------------
 structure_results$pop <- factor(
    structure_results$pop,
    levels = pop_levels
  )

  # --- compute reference means and thresholds
  ref_means <- structure_results %>%
    filter(pop %in% c("Dog",
                         "Sim-BC2d_CRO", "Sim-BC1d_CRO", "Sim-F1_CRO", "Sim-BC1w_CRO", "Sim-BC2w_CRO",
                      "W-Croatia", "Sim-W-Croatia")) %>%

 
    group_by(pop) %>%
    summarise(mean_qDog = mean(Dog, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")

  mean_dog  <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Dog", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC2d <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC2d", ref_means$pop)])  
  mean_BC1d <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC1d", ref_means$pop)])
  
  mean_F1   <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-F1", ref_means$pop)])

  mean_BC1w  <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC1w", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC2w <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC2w", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_wolf <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[ref_means$pop %in% c("W-Croatia")])

# Dog-side thresholds

thresh_BC2d <- (mean_dog  + mean_BC2d) / 2
thresh_BC1d <- (mean_BC2d + mean_BC1d) / 2
thresh_F1   <- (mean_BC1d + mean_F1)   / 2

# Wolf-side thresholds
thresh_BC1w <- (mean_F1   + mean_BC1w) / 2
thresh_BC2w <- (mean_BC1w + mean_BC2w) / 2
thresh_wolf <- (mean_BC2w + mean_wolf) / 2

  thresholds_raw <- c(
  BC2d  = thresh_BC2d,
  BC1d  = thresh_BC1d,
  F1    = thresh_F1,
  BC1w  = thresh_BC1w,
  BC2w  = thresh_BC2w,
  Wolf  = thresh_wolf)
  
  thresholds_adj <- thresholds_raw %>%
    pmax(c(
    0.9,  # BC2d minimum
    0.8,  # BC1d minimum
    0.6,  # F1 minimum 
    0.3,  # BC1w minimum
    0.1,  # BC2w minimum
    0.05   # Wolf cutoff 
    )) %>%
    round(3) %>%
    setNames(names(thresholds_raw))
  

  thresh_BC2d <- thresholds_adj["BC2d"]
  thresh_BC1d <- thresholds_adj["BC1d"]
  thresh_BC2w <- thresholds_adj["BC2w"]
  thresh_BC1w <- thresholds_adj["BC1w"]
  thresh_F1   <- thresholds_adj["F1"]
  thresh_wolf   <- thresholds_adj["Wolf"]

  # --- classify samples
structure_results_categories <- structure_results %>%
  mutate(across(c(Dog, Croatia), as.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(
    hy_verdict = case_when(
      Dog >= thresh_BC2d        ~ "Dog",
      Dog >= thresh_BC1d        ~ "BC2d",
      Dog >= thresh_F1          ~ "BC1d",
      Dog >= thresh_BC1w        ~ "F1",
      Dog >= thresh_BC2w        ~ "BC1w",
      Dog >= thresh_wolf        ~ "BC2w",
      TRUE                      ~ "Wolf"
  ))

  # ------------------------------------------
  # PLOT 1: DENSITY PLOT
  # ------------------------------------------
  thresholds_df <- data.frame(
  value = c(
    thresh_wolf,
    thresh_BC2w,
    thresh_BC1w,
    thresh_F1,
    thresh_BC1d,
    thresh_BC2d
  ),
  label = c(
    paste0("wolf < ", round(thresh_wolf, 3), " > BC2w"),
    paste0("BC2w < ", round(thresh_BC2w, 3), " > BC1w"),
    paste0("BC1w < ", round(thresh_BC1w, 3), " > F1"),
    paste0("F1 < ", round(thresh_F1, 3), " > BC1d"),
    paste0("BC1d < ", round(thresh_BC1d, 3), " > BC2d"),
    paste0("BC2d < ", round(thresh_BC2d, 3), " > dog")
  )
)
  p_density <- structure_results %>%
    filter(pop %in% names(color_map)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=Dog, fill=pop)) +
    geom_density(alpha=0.5, adjust=1) +
    geom_vline(data=thresholds_df, aes(xintercept=value),
               linetype="dashed", color="red", linewidth=0.6) +
    geom_text(data=thresholds_df, aes(x=value, y=45, label=label),
              inherit.aes=FALSE, angle=90, vjust=-0.4, size=3, color="red") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,50)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=color_map) +
    theme(legend.position="right", legend.title=element_blank()) +
    labs(title=paste("Distribution of dog Q-values – simulation replicate", seed),
         subtitle="Dashed red lines show hybrid thresholds",
         x="Q_Dog value", y="Density (capped at 50)")

  ggsave(file.path(paste0("ParallelStructure_Results/2ai_Croatia_low_numbers/R_results/2ai_Croatia_low_numbers_",seed,"_density_plot.png")),
         p_density, width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

# ------------------------------------------
# PLOT 2: HEATMAP OF POP VS. HYBRID CLASS
# ------------------------------------------
table_data_plot <- table(structure_results_categories$pop,
                         structure_results_categories$hy_verdict)
categories_plot <- as.data.frame(table_data_plot)
names(categories_plot) <- c("pop","hy_verdict","count")

# fixed order for populations and hybrid classes


hy_levels <- c(
  "Dog", "BC2d","BC1d", "F1", "BC1w", "BC2w",
 "Wolf"
)

# apply factor levels for consistent order across all seeds
categories_plot$pop <- factor(categories_plot$pop, levels = pop_levels)
categories_plot$hy_verdict <- factor(categories_plot$hy_verdict, levels = hy_levels)

p_heatmap <- ggplot(categories_plot, aes(x = pop, y = hy_verdict, fill = count)) +

  scale_fill_gradientn(
  colours = c("white", "#deebf7", "#6baed6", "#2171b5"),
  values = scales::rescale(c(0, 3, max(categories_plot$count) * 0.5, max(categories_plot$count))))+

        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")) +

       x = "Actual group",
       y = "STRUCTURE assignment results")

ggsave(file.path(paste0("ParallelStructure_Results/2ai_Croatia_low_numbers/R_results/2ai_Croatia_low_numbers_", seed, "_heatmap.png")),
       p_heatmap, width = 11, height = 6, dpi = 300)

}
```

Statistics - Hybrid classification accuracy
```{r}
# =====================================================
# SETTINGS
# =====================================================

seeds <- 1:10
base_dir <- "ParallelStructure_Results/2ai_Croatia_low_numbers"

# cluster order per seed (manually tune if needed)
cluster_orders <- list(
  "1"=c("Dog","Croatia"),
  "2"=c("Dog","Croatia"),
  "3"=c("Dog","Croatia"),
  "4"=c("Dog","Croatia"),
  "5"=c("Dog","Croatia"),
  "6"=c("Dog","Croatia"),
  "7"=c("Dog","Croatia"),
  "8"=c("Dog","Croatia"),
  "9"=c("Dog","Croatia"),
  "10"=c("Dog","Croatia")
)

pop_levels <- c(
  "Dog",
  "Sim-BC2d_CRO","Sim-BC1d_CRO",
  "F1","Sim-F1_CRO",
  "BC1w","Sim-BC1w_CRO",
  "BC2w","Sim-BC2w_CRO",
  "W-Croatia"
)

expected_cols <- c("Dog","BC2d","BC1d","F1","BC1w","BC2w","Wolf")

# =====================================================
# 1️⃣ LOAD ALL SEEDS AND CLASSIFY
# =====================================================

all_results <- list()

for (seed in seeds) {

  folder <- file.path(base_dir, paste0("2ai_Croatia_low_numbers_", seed))
  input_file <- file.path(folder, paste0("2ai_Croatia_low_numbers_", seed, ".txt"))
  pop_file   <- file.path(folder, paste0("2ai_Croatia_low_numbers_", seed, "_POP.txt"))
  clumpp_file <- file.path(folder, "Clumpak_results/K=2/MajorCluster/CLUMPP.files/ClumppIndFile.output")

  struct_res <- read.table(clumpp_file)
  struct_input <- read.table(input_file, skip=1, as.is=TRUE)
  struct_legend <- read.table(pop_file, header=FALSE, sep=" ", as.is=TRUE)
  names(struct_legend) <- c("id","pop")

  structure_results <- cbind(struct_input[,1:2], struct_res[,6:7])
  names(structure_results) <- c("Sample","Pop", cluster_orders[[as.character(seed)]])
  structure_results$Pop <- as.character(structure_results$Pop)
  struct_legend$id <- as.character(struct_legend$id)

  structure_results <- left_join(structure_results, struct_legend, by=c("Pop"="id"))

  structure_results$pop <- factor(structure_results$pop, levels=pop_levels)

  # =====================================================
  # THRESHOLDS (FROM CODE 2)
  # =====================================================

  ref_means <- structure_results %>%
    filter(pop %in% pop_levels) %>%
    group_by(pop) %>%
    summarise(mean_qDog = mean(as.numeric(Dog), na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")

  mean_dog  <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Dog", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC2d <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC2d", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC1d <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC1d", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_F1   <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-F1", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC1w  <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC1w", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC2w <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC2w", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_wolf <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[ref_means$pop %in% c("W-Croatia")])

  thresh_BC2d <- (mean_dog + mean_BC2d)/2
  thresh_BC1d <- (mean_BC2d + mean_BC1d)/2
  thresh_F1   <- (mean_BC1d + mean_F1)/2
  thresh_BC1w  <- (mean_F1 + mean_BC1w)/2
  thresh_BC2w <- (mean_BC1w + mean_BC2w)/2
  thresh_wolf <- (mean_BC2w + mean_wolf)/2

  thresholds_raw <- c(
    BC2d=thresh_BC2d,
    BC1d=thresh_BC1d,
    F1=thresh_F1,
    BC1w=thresh_BC1w,
    BC2w=thresh_BC2w,
    Wolf=thresh_wolf
  )

  thresholds_adj <- thresholds_raw %>%
    pmax(c(0.9,0.8,0.6,0.3,0.1,0.05)) %>%
    round(3) %>%
    setNames(names(thresholds_raw))

  thresh_BC2d <- thresholds_adj["BC2d"]
  thresh_BC1d <- thresholds_adj["BC1d"]
  thresh_F1   <- thresholds_adj["F1"]
  thresh_BC1w  <- thresholds_adj["BC1w"]
  thresh_BC2w <- thresholds_adj["BC2w"]
  thresh_wolf <- thresholds_adj["Wolf"]

  # =====================================================
  # CLASSIFICATION
  # =====================================================

  classified <- structure_results %>%
    mutate(across(c(Dog,Croatia), as.numeric)) %>%
    mutate(
      hy_verdict = case_when(
        Dog >= thresh_BC2d ~ "Dog",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1d ~ "BC2d",
        Dog >= thresh_F1   ~ "BC1d",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1w  ~ "F1",
        Dog >= thresh_BC2w ~ "BC1w",
        Dog >= thresh_wolf ~ "BC2w",
        TRUE ~ "Wolf"
      ),
      seed = seed
    ) %>%
    select(pop, hy_verdict, seed)

  all_results[[as.character(seed)]] <- classified
}

all_classifications <- bind_rows(all_results)

# =====================================================
# 2️⃣ CALCULATE % PER SEED
# =====================================================

seed_counts <- all_classifications %>%
  mutate(
    pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels),
    classified_group = ifelse(hy_verdict %in% wolf_classes, "Wolf", hy_verdict)
  ) %>%
  count(seed, pop, classified_group) %>%
  complete(seed, pop = pop_levels, classified_group = expected_cols, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  group_by(seed, pop) %>%
  mutate(percentage = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

# =====================================================
# 3️⃣ PER-SEED TABLES
# =====================================================

seed_tables <- seed_counts %>%
  select(seed, pop, classified_group, percentage) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group,
              values_from = percentage,
              values_fill = 0)

# =====================================================
# 4️⃣ MEAN + SD + SE + CI (FROM CODE 3)
# =====================================================

summary_stats <- seed_counts %>%
  group_by(pop, classified_group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(percentage),
    sd   = sd(percentage),
    n    = n(),
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    ci_lower = mean - qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se,
    ci_upper = mean + qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- mean only
mean_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group, values_from = mean, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop) %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols))

# --- mean ± SD
mean_sd_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, sd) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group, values_from = c(mean, sd))

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_sd_table[[cls]] <- sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f",
                                  mean_sd_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
                                  mean_sd_table[[paste0("sd_", cls)]])
}

mean_sd_table <- mean_sd_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)

# --- mean ± SE
mean_se_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, se) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group, values_from = c(mean, se))

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_se_table[[cls]] <- sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f",
                                  mean_se_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
                                  mean_se_table[[paste0("se_", cls)]])
}

mean_se_table <- mean_se_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)

# --- mean ± CI
mean_ci_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, ci_lower, ci_upper) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group,
              values_from = c(mean, ci_lower, ci_upper))

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_ci_table[[cls]] <- sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)",
                                  mean_ci_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
                                  mean_ci_table[[paste0("ci_lower_", cls)]],
                                  mean_ci_table[[paste0("ci_upper_", cls)]])
}

mean_ci_table <- mean_ci_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)

# =====================================================
# 5️⃣ EXPORT
# =====================================================

wb <- createWorkbook()

for (s in seeds) {
  seed_sheet <- seed_tables %>%
    filter(seed == s) %>%
    mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
    arrange(pop) %>%
    select(pop, all_of(expected_cols))

  addWorksheet(wb, paste0("Seed_", s))
  writeData(wb, paste0("Seed_", s), seed_sheet)
}

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_only")
writeData(wb, "Mean_only", mean_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_plus_SD")
writeData(wb, "Mean_plus_SD", mean_sd_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_plus_SE")
writeData(wb, "Mean_plus_SE", mean_se_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_plus_CI")
writeData(wb, "Mean_plus_CI", mean_ci_table)


saveWorkbook(
  wb,
  "ParallelStructure_Results/2ai_Croatia_low_numbers/R_results/2ai_K2_Hybrid_classification_accuracy_seed_1-10-SD_SE_Cl.xlsx",
  overwrite=TRUE
)
```

```{r}
      Dog >= thresh_BC1w        ~ "F1",
      Dog >= thresh_BC2w        ~ "BC1w",
      Dog >= thresh_wolf        ~ "BC2w",
      TRUE                      ~ "Wolf"
  ))

  # ------------------------------------------
  # PLOT 1: DENSITY PLOT
  # ------------------------------------------
  thresholds_df <- data.frame(
  value = c(
    thresh_wolf,
    thresh_BC2w,
    thresh_BC1w,
    thresh_F1,
    thresh_BC1d,
    thresh_BC2d
  ),
  label = c(
    paste0("wolf < ", round(thresh_wolf, 3), " > BC2w"),
    paste0("BC2w < ", round(thresh_BC2w, 3), " > BC1w"),
    paste0("BC1w < ", round(thresh_BC1w, 3), " > F1"),
    paste0("F1 < ", round(thresh_F1, 3), " > BC1d"),
    paste0("BC1d < ", round(thresh_BC1d, 3), " > BC2d"),
    paste0("BC2d < ", round(thresh_BC2d, 3), " > dog")
  )
)
  p_density <- structure_results %>%
    filter(pop %in% names(color_map)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=Dog, fill=pop)) +
    geom_density(alpha=0.5, adjust=1) +
    geom_vline(data=thresholds_df, aes(xintercept=value),
               linetype="dashed", color="red", linewidth=0.6) +
    geom_text(data=thresholds_df, aes(x=value, y=45, label=label),
              inherit.aes=FALSE, angle=90, vjust=-0.4, size=3, color="red") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,50)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=color_map) +
    theme(legend.position="right", legend.title=element_blank()) +
    labs(title=paste("Distribution of dog Q-values – simulation replicate", seed),
         subtitle="Dashed red lines show hybrid thresholds",
         x="Q_Dog value", y="Density (capped at 50)")

  ggsave(file.path(paste0("ParallelStructure_Results/2aii_Italy_low_numbers/R_results/2aii_Italy_low_numbers_",seed,"_density_plot.png")),
         p_density, width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

# ------------------------------------------
# PLOT 2: HEATMAP OF POP VS. HYBRID CLASS
# ------------------------------------------
table_data_plot <- table(structure_results_categories$pop,
                         structure_results_categories$hy_verdict)
categories_plot <- as.data.frame(table_data_plot)
names(categories_plot) <- c("pop","hy_verdict","count")

# fixed order for populations and hybrid classes


hy_levels <- c(
  "Dog", "BC2d","BC1d", "F1", "BC1w", "BC2w",
 "Wolf"
)

# apply factor levels for consistent order across all seeds
categories_plot$pop <- factor(categories_plot$pop, levels = pop_levels)
categories_plot$hy_verdict <- factor(categories_plot$hy_verdict, levels = hy_levels)

p_heatmap <- ggplot(categories_plot, aes(x = pop, y = hy_verdict, fill = count)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = count), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
  colours = c("white", "#deebf7", "#6baed6", "#2171b5"),
  values = scales::rescale(c(0, 3, max(categories_plot$count) * 0.5, max(categories_plot$count))))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 8),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")) +
  labs(title = paste("STRUCTURE assignment results vs. actual group – simulation replicate", seed),
       x = "Actual group",
       y = "STRUCTURE assignment results")

ggsave(file.path(paste0("ParallelStructure_Results/2aii_Italy_low_numbers/R_results/2aii_Italy_low_numbers_", seed, "_heatmap.png")),
       p_heatmap, width = 11, height = 6, dpi = 300)
}
```

Statistics - Hybrid classification accuracy
```{r}
# =====================================================
# SETTINGS
# =====================================================


seeds <- 1:10
base_dir <- "ParallelStructure_Results/2aii_Italy_low_numbers"

# cluster order per seed (manually tune if needed)
cluster_orders <- list(
  "1" = c("Dog","Italy"),  
  "2" = c("Dog","Italy"),  
  "3" = c("Dog","Italy"),  
  "4" = c("Dog","Italy"),  
  "5" = c("Dog","Italy"),
  "6" = c("Dog","Italy"),  
  "7" = c("Dog","Italy"),  
  "8" = c("Dog","Italy"),  
  "9" = c("Dog","Italy"),  
  "10" = c("Dog","Italy")
)

pop_levels <- c(
"Dog",
"Sim-BC2d_ITA", "Sim-BC1d_ITA", "Sim-F1_ITA", "Sim-BC1w_ITA", "Sim-BC2w_ITA",
"W-Italy", "Sim-W-Italy"
)

wolf_classes <- c("W-Italy")
expected_cols <- c(  "Dog", "BC2d","BC1d", "F1", "BC1w", "BC2w", "Wolf")


# =====================================================
# 1️⃣ LOAD ALL SEEDS AND CLASSIFY
# =====================================================

all_results <- list()

for (seed in seeds) {

  folder <- file.path(base_dir, paste0("2aii_Italy_low_numbers_", seed))
  input_file <- file.path(folder, paste0("2aii_Italy_low_numbers_", seed, ".txt"))
  pop_file   <- file.path(folder, paste0("2aii_Italy_low_numbers_", seed, "_POP.txt"))
  clumpp_file <- file.path(folder, "Clumpak_results/K=2/MajorCluster/CLUMPP.files/ClumppIndFile.output")

  struct_res <- read.table(clumpp_file)
  struct_input <- read.table(input_file, skip=1, as.is=TRUE)
  struct_legend <- read.table(pop_file, header=FALSE, sep=" ", as.is=TRUE)
  names(struct_legend) <- c("id","pop")

  structure_results <- cbind(struct_input[,1:2], struct_res[,6:7])
  names(structure_results) <- c("Sample","Pop", cluster_orders[[as.character(seed)]])
  structure_results$Pop <- as.character(structure_results$Pop)
  struct_legend$id <- as.character(struct_legend$id)

  structure_results <- left_join(structure_results, struct_legend, by=c("Pop"="id"))

  structure_results$pop <- factor(structure_results$pop, levels=pop_levels)

  # =====================================================
  # THRESHOLDS (FROM CODE 2)
  # =====================================================

  ref_means <- structure_results %>%
    filter(pop %in% pop_levels) %>%
    group_by(pop) %>%
    summarise(mean_qDog = mean(as.numeric(Dog), na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")

  mean_dog  <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Dog", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC2d <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC2d", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC1d <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC1d", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_F1   <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-F1", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC1w  <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC1w", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC2w <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC2w", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_wolf <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[ref_means$pop %in% c("W-Italy")])

  thresh_BC2d <- (mean_dog + mean_BC2d)/2
  thresh_BC1d <- (mean_BC2d + mean_BC1d)/2
  thresh_F1   <- (mean_BC1d + mean_F1)/2
  thresh_BC1w  <- (mean_F1 + mean_BC1w)/2
  thresh_BC2w <- (mean_BC1w + mean_BC2w)/2
  thresh_wolf <- (mean_BC2w + mean_wolf)/2

  thresholds_raw <- c(
    BC2d=thresh_BC2d,
    BC1d=thresh_BC1d,
    F1=thresh_F1,
    BC1w=thresh_BC1w,
    BC2w=thresh_BC2w,
    Wolf=thresh_wolf
  )

  thresholds_adj <- thresholds_raw %>%
    pmax(c(0.9,0.8,0.6,0.3,0.1,0.05)) %>%
    round(3) %>%
    setNames(names(thresholds_raw))

  thresh_BC2d <- thresholds_adj["BC2d"]
  thresh_BC1d <- thresholds_adj["BC1d"]
  thresh_F1   <- thresholds_adj["F1"]
  thresh_BC1w  <- thresholds_adj["BC1w"]
  thresh_BC2w <- thresholds_adj["BC2w"]
  thresh_wolf <- thresholds_adj["Wolf"]

  # =====================================================
  # CLASSIFICATION
  # =====================================================

  classified <- structure_results %>%
    mutate(across(c(Dog,Italy), as.numeric)) %>%
    mutate(
      hy_verdict = case_when(
        Dog >= thresh_BC2d ~ "Dog",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1d ~ "BC2d",
        Dog >= thresh_F1   ~ "BC1d",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1w  ~ "F1",
        Dog >= thresh_BC2w ~ "BC1w",
        Dog >= thresh_wolf ~ "BC2w",
        TRUE ~ "Wolf"
      ),
      seed = seed
    ) %>%
    select(pop, hy_verdict, seed)

  all_results[[as.character(seed)]] <- classified
}

all_classifications <- bind_rows(all_results)

# =====================================================
# 2️⃣ CALCULATE % PER SEED
# =====================================================

seed_counts <- all_classifications %>%
  mutate(
    pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels),
    classified_group = ifelse(hy_verdict %in% wolf_classes, "Wolf", hy_verdict)
  ) %>%
  count(seed, pop, classified_group) %>%
  complete(seed, pop = pop_levels, classified_group = expected_cols, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  group_by(seed, pop) %>%
  mutate(percentage = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

# =====================================================
# 3️⃣ PER-SEED TABLES
# =====================================================

seed_tables <- seed_counts %>%
  select(seed, pop, classified_group, percentage) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group,
              values_from = percentage,
              values_fill = 0)

# =====================================================
# 4️⃣ MEAN + SD + SE + CI (FROM CODE 3)
# =====================================================

summary_stats <- seed_counts %>%
  group_by(pop, classified_group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(percentage),
    sd   = sd(percentage),
    n    = n(),
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    ci_lower = mean - qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se,
    ci_upper = mean + qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- mean only
mean_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group, values_from = mean, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop) %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols))

# --- mean ± SD
mean_sd_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, sd) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group, values_from = c(mean, sd))

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_sd_table[[cls]] <- sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f",
                                  mean_sd_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
                                  mean_sd_table[[paste0("sd_", cls)]])
}

mean_sd_table <- mean_sd_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)

# --- mean ± SE
mean_se_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, se) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group, values_from = c(mean, se))

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_se_table[[cls]] <- sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f",
                                  mean_se_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
                                  mean_se_table[[paste0("se_", cls)]])
}

mean_se_table <- mean_se_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)

# --- mean ± CI
mean_ci_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, ci_lower, ci_upper) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group,
              values_from = c(mean, ci_lower, ci_upper))

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_ci_table[[cls]] <- sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)",
                                  mean_ci_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
                                  mean_ci_table[[paste0("ci_lower_", cls)]],
                                  mean_ci_table[[paste0("ci_upper_", cls)]])
}

mean_ci_table <- mean_ci_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)

# =====================================================
# 5️⃣ EXPORT
# =====================================================

wb <- createWorkbook()

for (s in seeds) {
  seed_sheet <- seed_tables %>%
    filter(seed == s) %>%
    mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
    arrange(pop) %>%
    select(pop, all_of(expected_cols))

  addWorksheet(wb, paste0("Seed_", s))
  writeData(wb, paste0("Seed_", s), seed_sheet)
}

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_only")
writeData(wb, "Mean_only", mean_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_plus_SD")
writeData(wb, "Mean_plus_SD", mean_sd_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_plus_SE")
writeData(wb, "Mean_plus_SE", mean_se_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_plus_CI")
writeData(wb, "Mean_plus_CI", mean_ci_table)


saveWorkbook(
  wb,
  "ParallelStructure_Results/2aii_Italy_low_numbers/R_results/2aii_K2_Hybrid_classification_accuracy_seed_1-10-SD_SE_Cl.xlsx",
  overwrite=TRUE
)
```

```{r}
)

pop_levels <- c(
  "Dog","Sim-dog",
  "Sim-BC2d_CRO", "Sim-BC1d_CRO", "F1","Sim-F1_CRO",
  "BC1w", "Sim-BC1w_CRO",  "BC2w","Sim-BC2w_CRO",
  "W-Croatia", "Sim-W-Croatia"
)

expected_cols <- c("Dog","BC2d","BC1d","F1","BC1w","BC2w","Wolf")

# =====================================================
# 1️⃣ LOAD ALL SEEDS AND CLASSIFY
# =====================================================

all_results <- list()

for (seed in seeds) {

  folder <- file.path(base_dir, paste0("2bi_Croatia_high_numbers_", seed))
  input_file <- file.path(folder, paste0("2bi_Croatia_high_numbers_", seed, ".txt"))
  pop_file   <- file.path(folder, paste0("2bi_Croatia_high_numbers_", seed, "_POP.txt"))
  clumpp_file <- file.path(folder, "Clumpak_results/K=2/MajorCluster/CLUMPP.files/ClumppIndFile.output")

  struct_res <- read.table(clumpp_file)
  struct_input <- read.table(input_file, skip=1, as.is=TRUE)
  struct_legend <- read.table(pop_file, header=FALSE, sep=" ", as.is=TRUE)
  names(struct_legend) <- c("id","pop")

  structure_results <- cbind(struct_input[,1:2], struct_res[,6:7])
  names(structure_results) <- c("Sample","Pop", cluster_orders[[as.character(seed)]])
  structure_results$Pop <- as.character(structure_results$Pop)
  struct_legend$id <- as.character(struct_legend$id)

  structure_results <- left_join(structure_results, struct_legend, by=c("Pop"="id"))

  structure_results$pop <- factor(structure_results$pop, levels=pop_levels)

  # =====================================================
  # THRESHOLDS (FROM CODE 2)
  # =====================================================

  ref_means <- structure_results %>%
    filter(pop %in% pop_levels) %>%
    group_by(pop) %>%
    summarise(mean_qDog = mean(as.numeric(Dog), na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")

  mean_dog  <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Dog", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC2d <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC2d", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC1d <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC1d", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_F1   <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-F1", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC1w  <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC1w", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC2w <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC2w", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_wolf <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[ref_means$pop %in% c("W-Croatia")])

  thresh_BC2d <- (mean_dog + mean_BC2d)/2
  thresh_BC1d <- (mean_BC2d + mean_BC1d)/2
  thresh_F1   <- (mean_BC1d + mean_F1)/2
  thresh_BC1w  <- (mean_F1 + mean_BC1w)/2
  thresh_BC2w <- (mean_BC1w + mean_BC2w)/2
  thresh_wolf <- (mean_BC2w + mean_wolf)/2

  thresholds_raw <- c(
    BC2d=thresh_BC2d,
    BC1d=thresh_BC1d,
    F1=thresh_F1,
    BC1w=thresh_BC1w,
    BC2w=thresh_BC2w,
    Wolf=thresh_wolf
  )

  thresholds_adj <- thresholds_raw %>%
    pmax(c(0.9,0.8,0.6,0.3,0.1,0.05)) %>%
    round(3) %>%
    setNames(names(thresholds_raw))

  thresh_BC2d <- thresholds_adj["BC2d"]
  thresh_BC1d <- thresholds_adj["BC1d"]
  thresh_F1   <- thresholds_adj["F1"]
  thresh_BC1w  <- thresholds_adj["BC1w"]
  thresh_BC2w <- thresholds_adj["BC2w"]
  thresh_wolf <- thresholds_adj["Wolf"]

  # =====================================================
  # CLASSIFICATION
  # =====================================================

  classified <- structure_results %>%
    mutate(across(c(Dog,Croatia), as.numeric)) %>%
    mutate(
      hy_verdict = case_when(
        Dog >= thresh_BC2d ~ "Dog",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1d ~ "BC2d",
        Dog >= thresh_F1   ~ "BC1d",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1w  ~ "F1",
        Dog >= thresh_BC2w ~ "BC1w",
        Dog >= thresh_wolf ~ "BC2w",
        TRUE ~ "Wolf"
      ),
      seed = seed
    ) %>%
    select(pop, hy_verdict, seed)

  all_results[[as.character(seed)]] <- classified
}

all_classifications <- bind_rows(all_results)

# =====================================================
# 2️⃣ CALCULATE % PER SEED
# =====================================================

seed_counts <- all_classifications %>%
  mutate(
    pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels),
    classified_group = ifelse(hy_verdict %in% wolf_classes, "Wolf", hy_verdict)
  ) %>%
  count(seed, pop, classified_group) %>%
  complete(seed, pop = pop_levels, classified_group = expected_cols, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  group_by(seed, pop) %>%
  mutate(percentage = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

# =====================================================
# 3️⃣ PER-SEED TABLES
# =====================================================

seed_tables <- seed_counts %>%
  select(seed, pop, classified_group, percentage) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group,
              values_from = percentage,
              values_fill = 0)

# =====================================================
# 4️⃣ MEAN + SD + SE + CI (FROM CODE 3)
# =====================================================

summary_stats <- seed_counts %>%
  group_by(pop, classified_group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(percentage),
    sd   = sd(percentage),
    n    = n(),
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    ci_lower = mean - qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se,
    ci_upper = mean + qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- mean only
mean_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group, values_from = mean, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop) %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols))

# --- mean ± SD
mean_sd_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, sd) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group, values_from = c(mean, sd))

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_sd_table[[cls]] <- sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f",
                                  mean_sd_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
                                  mean_sd_table[[paste0("sd_", cls)]])
}

mean_sd_table <- mean_sd_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)

# --- mean ± SE
mean_se_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, se) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group, values_from = c(mean, se))

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_se_table[[cls]] <- sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f",
                                  mean_se_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
                                  mean_se_table[[paste0("se_", cls)]])
}

mean_se_table <- mean_se_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)

# --- mean ± CI
mean_ci_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, ci_lower, ci_upper) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group,
              values_from = c(mean, ci_lower, ci_upper))

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_ci_table[[cls]] <- sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)",
                                  mean_ci_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
                                  mean_ci_table[[paste0("ci_lower_", cls)]],
                                  mean_ci_table[[paste0("ci_upper_", cls)]])
}

mean_ci_table <- mean_ci_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)

# =====================================================
# 5️⃣ EXPORT
# =====================================================

wb <- createWorkbook()

for (s in seeds) {
  seed_sheet <- seed_tables %>%
    filter(seed == s) %>%
    mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
    arrange(pop) %>%
    select(pop, all_of(expected_cols))

  addWorksheet(wb, paste0("Seed_", s))
  writeData(wb, paste0("Seed_", s), seed_sheet)
}

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_only")
writeData(wb, "Mean_only", mean_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_plus_SD")
writeData(wb, "Mean_plus_SD", mean_sd_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_plus_SE")
writeData(wb, "Mean_plus_SE", mean_se_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_plus_CI")
writeData(wb, "Mean_plus_CI", mean_ci_table)


saveWorkbook(
  wb,
  "ParallelStructure_Results/2bi_Croatia_high_numbers/R_results/2bi_K2_Hybrid_classification_accuracy_seed_1-10-SD_SE_Cl.xlsx",
  overwrite=TRUE
)
```

Classification and Q_Dog value for empirical hybrids and problematic wolves
```{r}

# =====================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# =====================================================
seeds <- 1:10
base_dir <- "ParallelStructure_Results/2bi_Croatia_high_numbers"

# cluster order per seed (manually tune if needed)
cluster_orders <- list(
  "1" = c("Dog","Croatia"), "2" = c("Dog","Croatia"),
  "3" = c("Dog","Croatia"), "4" = c("Dog","Croatia"),
  "5" = c("Dog","Croatia"), "6" = c("Dog","Croatia"),
  "7" = c("Dog","Croatia"), "8" = c("Dog","Croatia"),
  "9" = c("Dog","Croatia"), "10" = c("Dog","Croatia")
)

hybrid_labels <- c("BC2d","BC1d","F1","BC1w","BC2w")

# =====================================================
# 1️⃣ LOAD + CLASSIFY ALL SEEDS
# =====================================================
all_results <- list()

for (seed in seeds) {

  folder <- file.path(base_dir, paste0("2bi_Croatia_high_numbers_", seed))
  input_file  <- file.path(folder, paste0("2bi_Croatia_high_numbers_", seed, ".txt"))
  pop_file    <- file.path(folder, paste0("2bi_Croatia_high_numbers_", seed, "_POP.txt"))
  clumpp_file <- file.path(folder, "Clumpak_results/K=2/MajorCluster/CLUMPP.files/ClumppIndFile.output")

  struct_res    <- read.table(clumpp_file)
  struct_input  <- read.table(input_file, skip = 1, as.is = TRUE)
  struct_legend <- read.table(pop_file, header = FALSE, as.is = TRUE)
  names(struct_legend) <- c("id","pop")

  structure_results <- cbind(struct_input[,1:2], struct_res[,6:7])
  names(structure_results) <- c("Sample","Pop", cluster_orders[[as.character(seed)]])
  structure_results$Pop <- as.character(structure_results$Pop)
  struct_legend$id <- as.character(struct_legend$id)

  structure_results <- left_join(structure_results, struct_legend, by = c("Pop" = "id"))


  # ---- reference means (UNCHANGED)
  ref_means <- structure_results %>%
    filter(pop %in% c("Dog",
                      "Sim-BC2d_CRO","Sim-BC1d_CRO","Sim-F1_CRO",
                      "Sim-BC1w_CRO","Sim-BC2w_CRO",
                      "W-Croatia")) %>%
    group_by(pop) %>%
    summarise(mean_qDog = mean(Dog, na.rm = TRUE), .groups="drop")

  mean_dog   <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Dog", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC2d  <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC2d", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC1d  <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC1d", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_F1    <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-F1", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC1w  <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC1w", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC2w  <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC2w", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_wolf  <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[ref_means$pop=="W-Croatia"])

  thresholds <- c(
    BC2d = max((mean_dog  + mean_BC2d)/2, 0.9),
    BC1d = max((mean_BC2d + mean_BC1d)/2, 0.8),
    F1   = max((mean_BC1d + mean_F1)/2,   0.6),
    BC1w  = max((mean_F1   + mean_BC1w)/2,  0.3),
    BC2w = max((mean_BC1w  + mean_BC2w)/2, 0.1),
    Wolf = max((mean_BC2w + mean_wolf)/2, 0.05)
  )

  structure_results <- structure_results %>%
    mutate(across(c(Dog, Croatia), as.numeric)) %>%
    mutate(
      hy_verdict = case_when(
        Dog >= thresholds["BC2d"] ~ "Dog",
        Dog >= thresholds["BC1d"] ~ "BC2d",
        Dog >= thresholds["F1"]   ~ "BC1d",
        Dog >= thresholds["BC1w"]  ~ "F1",
        Dog >= thresholds["BC2w"] ~ "BC1w",
        Dog >= thresholds["Wolf"] ~ "BC2w",
        TRUE                      ~ "Wolf"
      ),
      seed = seed
    ) %>%
    select(Sample, pop, Dog, hy_verdict, seed)

  all_results[[as.character(seed)]] <- structure_results
}

all_classifications <- bind_rows(all_results)

# =====================================================
# 2️⃣ FILTER: EMPIRICAL ONLY, NO DOGS
# =====================================================
all_classifications_empirical <- all_classifications %>%
  filter(
    !grepl("^Sim-", pop),   # remove simulated samples
    pop != "Dog"            # remove dogs
  )

# =====================================================
# 3️⃣ SELECT ALL HYBRIDS + ONLY WOLVES EVER HYBRID
# =====================================================
samples_of_interest <- all_classifications_empirical %>%
  mutate(is_hybrid = hy_verdict %in% hybrid_labels) %>%
  group_by(Sample, pop) %>%
  summarise(ever_hybrid = any(is_hybrid), .groups="drop") %>%
  filter(pop != "W-Croatia" | ever_hybrid)

# =====================================================
# 4️⃣ PIVOT STRUCTURE Assignment Results (10 seeds)
# =====================================================
verdict_wide <- all_classifications_empirical %>%
  semi_join(samples_of_interest, by = c("Sample","pop")) %>%
  select(Sample, pop, seed, hy_verdict) %>%
  mutate(seed = paste0("Seed", seed, "_class")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = seed, values_from = hy_verdict)

# =====================================================
# 5️⃣ PIVOT Q_Dog valueS (10 seeds)
# =====================================================
qdog_wide <- all_classifications_empirical %>%
  semi_join(samples_of_interest, by = c("Sample","pop")) %>%
  select(Sample, pop, seed, Dog) %>%
  mutate(seed = paste0("Seed", seed, "_qDog")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = seed, values_from = Dog)

# =====================================================
# 6️⃣ FINAL 22-COLUMN TABLE
# =====================================================
final_hybrid_table <- verdict_wide %>%
  left_join(qdog_wide, by = c("Sample","pop")) %>%
  rename(
    SampleID = Sample,
    Population = pop
  ) %>%
  arrange(Population, SampleID)

# =====================================================
# 6b️⃣ COUNT CLASSIFICATIONS ACROSS SEEDS (FIXED)
# =====================================================

# Identify class columns
class_cols <- grep("_class$", names(final_hybrid_table), value = TRUE)

# Convert to long format
class_long <- final_hybrid_table %>%
  select(SampleID, Population, all_of(class_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(class_cols),
    names_to = "Seed",
    values_to = "Class"
  )

# Count classifications per sample
class_counts <- class_long %>%
  group_by(SampleID, Population, Class) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Pivot back to wide format
class_counts_wide <- class_counts %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Class,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0,
    names_prefix = "n_"
  )

# -----------------------------------------------------
# Combine all wolf-type assignments into one column
# -----------------------------------------------------

wolf_categories <- c(
  "W-Croatia"
)

# -----------------------------------------------------
# Join back to main table
# -----------------------------------------------------

final_hybrid_table <- final_hybrid_table %>%
  left_join(class_counts_wide, by = c("SampleID","Population"))
# =====================================================
# 7️⃣ EXPORT
# =====================================================
write.xlsx(
  final_hybrid_table,
  "ParallelStructure_Results/2bi_Croatia_high_numbers/R_results/2bi_Empirical_hybrids_and_problematic_wolves_all_seeds.xlsx",
  rowNames = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
 structure_results$pop <- factor(

  mean_dog  <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Dog", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC2d <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC2d", ref_means$pop)])

  mean_BC1w  <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC1w", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC2w <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC2w", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_wolf <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[ref_means$pop %in% c("W-Italy")])

# Dog-side thresholds

thresh_BC2d <- (mean_dog  + mean_BC2d) / 2
thresh_BC1d <- (mean_BC2d + mean_BC1d) / 2
thresh_F1   <- (mean_BC1d + mean_F1)   / 2

# Wolf-side thresholds
thresh_BC1w <- (mean_F1   + mean_BC1w) / 2
thresh_BC2w <- (mean_BC1w + mean_BC2w) / 2
thresh_wolf <- (mean_BC2w + mean_wolf) / 2

  thresholds_raw <- c(

  thresholds_adj <- thresholds_raw %>%
```
