```{r}
    0.1,  # BC2w minimum
    0.05   # Wolf cutoff 
    )) %>%
    round(3) %>%
    setNames(names(thresholds_raw))
  
  stopifnot(  #SANITY CHECK
  thresh_BC2d > thresh_BC1d,
  thresh_BC1d > thresh_F1,
  thresh_F1   > thresh_BC1w,
  thresh_BC1w > thresh_BC2w,
  thresh_BC2w > thresh_wolf
)

  thresh_BC2d <- thresholds_adj["BC2d"]
  thresh_BC1d <- thresholds_adj["BC1d"]
  thresh_BC2w <- thresholds_adj["BC2w"]
  thresh_BC1w <- thresholds_adj["BC1w"]
  thresh_F1   <- thresholds_adj["F1"]
  thresh_wolf   <- thresholds_adj["Wolf"]

  # --- classify samples

      Dog >= thresh_BC1w        ~ "F1",
      Dog >= thresh_BC2w        ~ "BC1w",
      Dog >= thresh_wolf        ~ "BC2w",
      TRUE                      ~ "Wolf"
  ))

  # ------------------------------------------
  # PLOT 1: DENSITY PLOT
  # ------------------------------------------
  thresholds_df <- data.frame(
  value = c(
    thresh_wolf,
    thresh_BC2w,
    thresh_BC1w,
    thresh_F1,
    thresh_BC1d,
    thresh_BC2d
  ),
  label = c(
    paste0("wolf < ", round(thresh_wolf, 3), " > BC2w"),
    paste0("BC2w < ", round(thresh_BC2w, 3), " > BC1w"),
    paste0("BC1w < ", round(thresh_BC1w, 3), " > F1"),
    paste0("F1 < ", round(thresh_F1, 3), " > BC1d"),
    paste0("BC1d < ", round(thresh_BC1d, 3), " > BC2d"),
    paste0("BC2d < ", round(thresh_BC2d, 3), " > dog")
  )
)
  p_density <- structure_results %>%
    filter(pop %in% names(color_map)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=Dog, fill=pop)) +
    geom_density(alpha=0.5, adjust=1) +
    geom_vline(data=thresholds_df, aes(xintercept=value),
               linetype="dashed", color="red", linewidth=0.6) +
    geom_text(data=thresholds_df, aes(x=value, y=45, label=label),

         subtitle="Dashed red lines show hybrid thresholds",
         x="Q_Dog value", y="Density (capped at 50)")

  ggsave(file.path(paste0("ParallelStructure_Results/2bii_Italy_high_numbers/R_results/2bii_Italy_high_numbers_",seed,"_density_plot.png")),
         p_density, width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

# ------------------------------------------

                         structure_results_categories$hy_verdict)
categories_plot <- as.data.frame(table_data_plot)
names(categories_plot) <- c("pop","hy_verdict","count")

# fixed order for populations and hybrid classes

 "Wolf"
)

# apply factor levels for consistent order across all seeds
```

Statistics - Hybrid classification accuracy
```{r}
# =====================================================
# SETTINGS
# =====================================================


seeds <- 1:10
base_dir <- "ParallelStructure_Results/2bii_Italy_high_numbers"

# cluster order per seed (manually tune if needed)
cluster_orders <- list(
  "1" = c("Dog","Italy"),  
  "2" = c("Dog","Italy"),  
  "3" = c("Dog","Italy"),  
  "4" = c("Dog","Italy"),  
  "5" = c("Dog","Italy"),
  "6" = c("Dog","Italy"),  
  "7" = c("Dog","Italy"),  
  "8" = c("Dog","Italy"),  
  "9" = c("Dog","Italy"),  
  "10" = c("Dog","Italy")
)

pop_levels <- c(
"Dog","Sim-dog",
"Sim-BC2d_ITA", "Sim-BC1d_ITA", "Sim-F1_ITA", "Sim-BC1w_ITA", "Sim-BC2w_ITA",
"W-Italy", "Sim-W-Italy"
)

wolf_classes <- c("W-Italy")
expected_cols <- c(  "Dog", "BC2d","BC1d", "F1", "BC1w", "BC2w", "Wolf")


# =====================================================
# 1️⃣ LOAD ALL SEEDS AND CLASSIFY
# =====================================================

all_results <- list()

for (seed in seeds) {


  folder <- file.path(base_dir, paste0("2bii_Italy_high_numbers_", seed))
  input_file <- file.path(folder, paste0("2bii_Italy_high_numbers_", seed, ".txt"))
  pop_file   <- file.path(folder, paste0("2bii_Italy_high_numbers_", seed, "_POP.txt"))
  clumpp_file <- file.path(folder, "Clumpak_results/K=2/MajorCluster/CLUMPP.files/ClumppIndFile.output")

  struct_res <- read.table(clumpp_file)
  struct_input <- read.table(input_file, skip=1, as.is=TRUE)
  struct_legend <- read.table(pop_file, header=FALSE, sep=" ", as.is=TRUE)
  names(struct_legend) <- c("id","pop")

  structure_results <- cbind(struct_input[,1:2], struct_res[,6:7])
  names(structure_results) <- c("Sample","Pop", cluster_orders[[as.character(seed)]])
  structure_results$Pop <- as.character(structure_results$Pop)
  struct_legend$id <- as.character(struct_legend$id)

  structure_results <- left_join(structure_results, struct_legend, by=c("Pop"="id"))

  structure_results$pop <- factor(structure_results$pop, levels=pop_levels)

  # =====================================================
  # THRESHOLDS (FROM CODE 2)
  # =====================================================

  ref_means <- structure_results %>%
    filter(pop %in% pop_levels) %>%
    group_by(pop) %>%
    summarise(mean_qDog = mean(as.numeric(Dog), na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")

  mean_dog  <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Dog", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC2d <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC2d", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC1d <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC1d", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_F1   <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-F1", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC1w  <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC1w", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC2w <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC2w", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_wolf <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[ref_means$pop %in% c("W-Italy")])

  thresh_BC2d <- (mean_dog + mean_BC2d)/2
  thresh_BC1d <- (mean_BC2d + mean_BC1d)/2
  thresh_F1   <- (mean_BC1d + mean_F1)/2
  thresh_BC1w  <- (mean_F1 + mean_BC1w)/2
  thresh_BC2w <- (mean_BC1w + mean_BC2w)/2
  thresh_wolf <- (mean_BC2w + mean_wolf)/2

  thresholds_raw <- c(
    BC2d=thresh_BC2d,
    BC1d=thresh_BC1d,
    F1=thresh_F1,
    BC1w=thresh_BC1w,
    BC2w=thresh_BC2w,
    Wolf=thresh_wolf
  )

  thresholds_adj <- thresholds_raw %>%
    pmax(c(0.9,0.8,0.6,0.3,0.1,0.05)) %>%
    round(3) %>%
    setNames(names(thresholds_raw))

  thresh_BC2d <- thresholds_adj["BC2d"]
  thresh_BC1d <- thresholds_adj["BC1d"]
  thresh_F1   <- thresholds_adj["F1"]
  thresh_BC1w  <- thresholds_adj["BC1w"]
  thresh_BC2w <- thresholds_adj["BC2w"]
  thresh_wolf <- thresholds_adj["Wolf"]

  # =====================================================
  # CLASSIFICATION
  # =====================================================

  classified <- structure_results %>%
    mutate(across(c(Dog,Italy), as.numeric)) %>%
    mutate(
      hy_verdict = case_when(
        Dog >= thresh_BC2d ~ "Dog",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1d ~ "BC2d",
        Dog >= thresh_F1   ~ "BC1d",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1w  ~ "F1",
        Dog >= thresh_BC2w ~ "BC1w",
        Dog >= thresh_wolf ~ "BC2w",
        TRUE ~ "Wolf"
      ),
      seed = seed
    ) %>%
    select(pop, hy_verdict, seed)

  all_results[[as.character(seed)]] <- classified
}

all_classifications <- bind_rows(all_results)

# =====================================================
# 2️⃣ CALCULATE % PER SEED
# =====================================================

seed_counts <- all_classifications %>%
  mutate(
    pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels),
    classified_group = ifelse(hy_verdict %in% wolf_classes, "Wolf", hy_verdict)
  ) %>%
  count(seed, pop, classified_group) %>%
  complete(seed, pop = pop_levels, classified_group = expected_cols, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  group_by(seed, pop) %>%
  mutate(percentage = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

# =====================================================
# 3️⃣ PER-SEED TABLES
# =====================================================

seed_tables <- seed_counts %>%
  select(seed, pop, classified_group, percentage) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group,
              values_from = percentage,
              values_fill = 0)

# =====================================================
# 4️⃣ MEAN + SD + SE + CI (FROM CODE 3)
# =====================================================

summary_stats <- seed_counts %>%
  group_by(pop, classified_group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(percentage),
    sd   = sd(percentage),
    n    = n(),
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    ci_lower = mean - qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se,
    ci_upper = mean + qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- mean only
mean_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group, values_from = mean, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop) %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols))

# --- mean ± SD
mean_sd_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, sd) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group, values_from = c(mean, sd))

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_sd_table[[cls]] <- sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f",
                                  mean_sd_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
                                  mean_sd_table[[paste0("sd_", cls)]])
}

mean_sd_table <- mean_sd_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)

# --- mean ± SE
mean_se_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, se) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group, values_from = c(mean, se))

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_se_table[[cls]] <- sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f",
                                  mean_se_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
                                  mean_se_table[[paste0("se_", cls)]])
}

mean_se_table <- mean_se_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)

# --- mean ± CI
mean_ci_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, ci_lower, ci_upper) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group,
              values_from = c(mean, ci_lower, ci_upper))

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_ci_table[[cls]] <- sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)",
                                  mean_ci_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
                                  mean_ci_table[[paste0("ci_lower_", cls)]],
                                  mean_ci_table[[paste0("ci_upper_", cls)]])
}

mean_ci_table <- mean_ci_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)

# =====================================================
# 5️⃣ EXPORT
# =====================================================

wb <- createWorkbook()

for (s in seeds) {
  seed_sheet <- seed_tables %>%
    filter(seed == s) %>%
    mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
    arrange(pop) %>%
    select(pop, all_of(expected_cols))

  addWorksheet(wb, paste0("Seed_", s))
  writeData(wb, paste0("Seed_", s), seed_sheet)
}

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_only")
writeData(wb, "Mean_only", mean_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_plus_SD")
writeData(wb, "Mean_plus_SD", mean_sd_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_plus_SE")
writeData(wb, "Mean_plus_SE", mean_se_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_plus_CI")
writeData(wb, "Mean_plus_CI", mean_ci_table)


saveWorkbook(
  wb,
  "ParallelStructure_Results/2bii_Italy_high_numbers/R_results/2bii_K2_Hybrid_classification_accuracy_seed_1-10-SD_SE_Cl.xlsx",
  overwrite=TRUE
)

```

2.3 All empirical samples with reference populations

3a) Empirical individuals only: Without balancing the populations STRUCTURE and CLUMPAK results were not good, so we did not analyse the data further.

3b) Empirical individuals and simulated reference samples to balance groups sizes

```{r}
for (seed in seeds) {

  folder <- file.path(base_dir, paste0("3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids_", seed))
  input_file <- file.path(folder, paste0("3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids_", seed, ".txt"))
  pop_file   <- file.path(folder, paste0("3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids_", seed, "_POP.txt"))
  clumpp_file <- file.path(folder, "Clumpak_results/K=6/MajorCluster/CLUMPP.files/ClumppIndFile.output")

  struct_res    <- read.table(clumpp_file)
  struct_input  <- read.table(input_file, skip = 1, as.is = TRUE)
  struct_legend <- read.table(pop_file, header = FALSE, sep = " ", as.is = TRUE)
  names(struct_legend) <- c("id","pop")

  structure_results <- cbind(struct_input[,1:2], struct_res[,6:11])
  names(structure_results) <- c("Sample","Pop", cluster_orders[[as.character(seed)]])
  structure_results$Pop <- as.character(structure_results$Pop)
  struct_legend$id <- as.character(struct_legend$id)

  structure_results <- left_join(structure_results, struct_legend,
                                 by = c("Pop" = "id"))

  structure_results$pop <- factor(structure_results$pop, levels = pop_levels)

  # =====================================================
  # THRESHOLDS 
  # =====================================================
  
  ref_means <- structure_results %>%
    group_by(pop) %>%
    summarise(mean_qDog = mean(as.numeric(Dog), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

thresholds_adj <- c(
  BC2d  = 0.94,
  BC1d  = 0.83,
  F1    = 0.64,
  BC1w  = 0.32,
  BC2w  = 0.12,
  Wolf  = 0.05)
  
  

  thresh_BC2d <- thresholds_adj["BC2d"]
  thresh_BC1d <- thresholds_adj["BC1d"]
  thresh_BC2w <- thresholds_adj["BC2w"]
  thresh_BC1w <- thresholds_adj["BC1w"]
  thresh_F1   <- thresholds_adj["F1"]
  thresh_wolf   <- thresholds_adj["Wolf"]

  classified <- structure_results %>%
    mutate(across(c(Dog,N_Dinaric,S_Balkan,Italy,Germany,Romania), as.numeric)) %>%
    mutate(
      hy_verdict = case_when(
        Dog >= thresh_BC2d ~ "Dog",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1d ~ "BC2d",
        Dog >= thresh_F1   ~ "BC1d",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1w  ~ "F1",
        Dog >= thresh_BC2w ~ "BC1w",
        Dog >= thresh_wolf ~ "BC2w",
        N_Dinaric > 0.7 ~ "N_Dinaric",
        S_Balkan  > 0.7 ~ "S_Balkan",
        Italy     > 0.7 ~ "Italian",
        Germany   > 0.7 ~ "German",
        Romania   > 0.7 ~ "Romanian",
        TRUE ~ "Mixed"
      ),
      seed = seed
    ) %>%
    select(pop, hy_verdict, seed)

  all_results[[as.character(seed)]] <- classified
}

all_classifications <- bind_rows(all_results)

# =====================================================
# 2️⃣ CALCULATE % PER SEED
# =====================================================

seed_counts <- all_classifications %>%
  mutate(
    pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels),
    classified_group = ifelse(hy_verdict %in% wolf_classes, "Wolf", hy_verdict)
  ) %>%
  count(seed, pop, classified_group) %>%
  complete(seed, pop = pop_levels, classified_group = expected_cols, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  group_by(seed, pop) %>%
  mutate(percentage = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

# =====================================================
# 3️⃣ PER-SEED TABLES
# =====================================================

seed_tables <- seed_counts %>%
  select(seed, pop, classified_group, percentage) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group,
              values_from = percentage,
              values_fill = 0)

# =====================================================
# 4️⃣ MEAN + SD + SE + CI (FROM CODE 3)
# =====================================================

summary_stats <- seed_counts %>%
  group_by(pop, classified_group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(percentage),
    sd   = sd(percentage),
    n    = n(),
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    ci_lower = mean - qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se,
    ci_upper = mean + qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- mean only
mean_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group, values_from = mean, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop) %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols))

# --- mean ± SD
mean_sd_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, sd) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group, values_from = c(mean, sd))

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_sd_table[[cls]] <- sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f",
                                  mean_sd_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
                                  mean_sd_table[[paste0("sd_", cls)]])
}

mean_sd_table <- mean_sd_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)

# --- mean ± SE
mean_se_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, se) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group, values_from = c(mean, se))

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_se_table[[cls]] <- sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f",
                                  mean_se_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
                                  mean_se_table[[paste0("se_", cls)]])
}

mean_se_table <- mean_se_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)

# --- mean ± CI
mean_ci_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, ci_lower, ci_upper) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group,
              values_from = c(mean, ci_lower, ci_upper))

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_ci_table[[cls]] <- sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)",
                                  mean_ci_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
                                  mean_ci_table[[paste0("ci_lower_", cls)]],
                                  mean_ci_table[[paste0("ci_upper_", cls)]])
}

mean_ci_table <- mean_ci_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)

# =====================================================
# 5️⃣ EXPORT
# =====================================================

wb <- createWorkbook()

for (s in seeds) {
  seed_sheet <- seed_tables %>%
    filter(seed == s) %>%
    mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
    arrange(pop) %>%
    select(pop, all_of(expected_cols))

  addWorksheet(wb, paste0("Seed_", s))
  writeData(wb, paste0("Seed_", s), seed_sheet)
}

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_only")
writeData(wb, "Mean_only", mean_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_plus_SD")
writeData(wb, "Mean_plus_SD", mean_sd_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_plus_SE")
writeData(wb, "Mean_plus_SE", mean_se_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_plus_CI")
writeData(wb, "Mean_plus_CI", mean_ci_table)

saveWorkbook(
  wb,
  "ParallelStructure_Results/3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids/R_results/3b_K6_Hybrid_classification_accuracy_per_seed_1-10_SD_SE_CI.xlsx",
  overwrite = TRUE
)
```

Classification and Q_Dog value for empirical hybrids and problematic wolves (K=6)
```{r}
# =====================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# =====================================================
seeds <- 1:10
base_dir <- "ParallelStructure_Results/3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids"

# cluster order per seed (manually tune if needed)
cluster_orders <- list(
  "1" = c("Dog",  "Germany", "N_Dinaric", "Italy","Romania", "S_Balkan"),
  "2" = c("Dog",  "Germany", "N_Dinaric", "Italy","Romania", "S_Balkan"),
  "3" = c("Dog",  "Romania", "N_Dinaric", "Italy","Germany", "S_Balkan"),
  "4" = c("Dog",  "Germany", "N_Dinaric", "Italy","Romania", "S_Balkan"),
  "5" = c("Dog",  "Germany", "N_Dinaric", "Italy","Romania", "S_Balkan"),
  "6" = c("Dog",  "Germany", "N_Dinaric", "Italy","Romania", "S_Balkan"),
  "7" = c("Dog",  "Germany", "S_Balkan", "Italy","Romania", "N_Dinaric"),
  "8" = c("Dog",  "Germany", "N_Dinaric", "Italy","Romania", "S_Balkan"),
  "9" = c("Dog",  "Germany", "N_Dinaric", "Italy","Romania", "S_Balkan"),
  "10" = c("Dog",  "Germany", "S_Balkan", "Italy","Romania", "N_Dinaric")
)

hybrid_labels <- c("BC2d","BC1d","F1","BC1w","BC2w")

wolf_pops <- c(
    "W-Slovenia","W-Croatia","W-Middle_Balkan","W-N.Macedonia",
  "W-Bulgaria","W-Italy","W-Germany","W-Romania"
)

desired_order <- c(
  "Dog","Sim-dog",
  "F1","BC1w","BC2w",
  "W-Slovenia","W-Croatia",
  "W-Middle_Balkan",
  "W-N.Macedonia","Sim-W-N.Macedonia",
  "W-Bulgaria","Sim-W-Bulgaria",
  "W-Italy","Sim-W-Italy",
  "W-Germany","Sim-W-Germany",
  "W-Romania","Sim-W-Romania"
)

thresholds_adj <- c(
  BC2d  = 0.94,
  BC1d  = 0.83,
  F1    = 0.64,
  BC1w  = 0.32,
  BC2w  = 0.12,
  Wolf  = 0.05)

# =====================================================
# 1️⃣ LOAD + CLASSIFY ALL SEEDS
# =====================================================
all_results <- list()

for (seed in seeds) {

  folder <- file.path(base_dir, paste0("3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids_", seed))
  input_file  <- file.path(folder, paste0("3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids_", seed, ".txt"))
  pop_file    <- file.path(folder, paste0("3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids_", seed, "_POP.txt"))
  clumpp_file <- file.path(folder, "Clumpak_results/K=6/MajorCluster/CLUMPP.files/ClumppIndFile.output")

  struct_res    <- read.table(clumpp_file)
  struct_input  <- read.table(input_file, skip = 1, as.is = TRUE)
  struct_legend <- read.table(pop_file, header = FALSE, as.is = TRUE)
  names(struct_legend) <- c("id","pop")

  structure_results <- cbind(struct_input[,1:2], struct_res[,6:11])
  names(structure_results) <- c("Sample","Pop", cluster_orders[[as.character(seed)]])
  structure_results$Pop <- as.character(structure_results$Pop)
  struct_legend$id <- as.character(struct_legend$id)

  structure_results <- left_join(structure_results, struct_legend,
                                 by = c("Pop" = "id"))

  structure_results <- structure_results %>%
    mutate(across(c(Dog, N_Dinaric, S_Balkan, Italy, Germany, Romania), as.numeric)) %>%
    mutate(
      hy_verdict = case_when(
        Dog >= thresholds_adj["BC2d"] ~ "Dog",
        Dog >= thresholds_adj["BC1d"] ~ "BC2d",
        Dog >= thresholds_adj["F1"]   ~ "BC1d",
        Dog >= thresholds_adj["BC1w"]  ~ "F1",
        Dog >= thresholds_adj["BC2w"] ~ "BC1w",
        Dog >= thresholds_adj["Wolf"] ~ "BC2w",
        N_Dinaric > 0.7 ~ "N_Dinaric",
        S_Balkan  > 0.7 ~ "S_Balkan",
        Italy     > 0.7 ~ "Italian",
        Germany   > 0.7 ~ "German",
        Romania   > 0.7 ~ "Romanian",
        TRUE ~ "Mixed"
      ),
      seed = seed
    ) %>%
    select(Sample, pop, Dog, hy_verdict, seed)

  all_results[[as.character(seed)]] <- structure_results
}

all_classifications <- bind_rows(all_results)

# =====================================================
# 2️⃣ EMPIRICAL ONLY + NO DOGS
# =====================================================
all_empirical <- all_classifications %>%
  filter(
    !grepl("^Sim-", pop),
    pop != "Dog"
  )

# =====================================================
# 3️⃣ SAMPLE SELECTION
# =====================================================
samples_of_interest <- all_empirical %>%
  mutate(is_hybrid = hy_verdict %in% hybrid_labels) %>%
  group_by(Sample, pop) %>%
  summarise(ever_hybrid = any(is_hybrid), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(
    (pop %in% wolf_pops & ever_hybrid) |
    !(pop %in% wolf_pops)
  )

# =====================================================
# 4️⃣ PIVOT: HYBRID CLASS
# =====================================================
verdict_wide <- all_empirical %>%
  semi_join(samples_of_interest, by = c("Sample","pop")) %>%
  select(Sample, pop, seed, hy_verdict) %>%
  mutate(seed = paste0("Seed", seed, "_class")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = seed, values_from = hy_verdict)

# =====================================================
# 5️⃣ PIVOT: qDog
# =====================================================
qdog_wide <- all_empirical %>%
  semi_join(samples_of_interest, by = c("Sample","pop")) %>%
  select(Sample, pop, seed, Dog) %>%
  mutate(seed = paste0("Seed", seed, "_qDog")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = seed, values_from = Dog)

# =====================================================
# 6️⃣ FINAL TABLE + ORDERING
# =====================================================
final_hybrid_table <- verdict_wide %>%
  left_join(qdog_wide, by = c("Sample","pop")) %>%
  rename(
    SampleID   = Sample,
    Population = pop
  ) %>%
  arrange(order(factor(Population, levels = desired_order)))

# =====================================================
# 6b COUNT CLASSIFICATIONS ACROSS SEEDS
# =====================================================

# Identify class columns
class_cols <- grep("_class$", names(final_hybrid_table), value = TRUE)

# Convert to long format
class_long <- final_hybrid_table %>%
  select(SampleID, Population, all_of(class_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(class_cols),
    names_to = "Seed",
    values_to = "Class"
  )

# Count classifications per sample
class_counts <- class_long %>%
  group_by(SampleID, Population, Class) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

# =====================================================
# Keep only the classifications of interest
# =====================================================

# Wolf categories to combine
wolf_categories <- c(
  "N_Dinaric",
  "S_Balkan",
  "Italian",
  "German",
  "Romanian",
  "Mixed"
)

# Hybrid categories to keep separately
hybrid_count_categories <- c(
  "BC2w",
  "BC1w",
  "F1"
)

# =====================================================
# Create counts for BC2w, BC1w and F1
# =====================================================

hybrid_counts_wide <- class_counts %>%
  filter(Class %in% hybrid_count_categories) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Class,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0,
    names_prefix = "n_"
  )

# Make sure all three columns exist
for (x in paste0("n_", hybrid_count_categories)) {
  if (!x %in% names(hybrid_counts_wide)) {
    hybrid_counts_wide[[x]] <- 0L
  }
}

# =====================================================
# Create combined wolf count
# =====================================================

wolf_counts <- class_counts %>%
  filter(Class %in% wolf_categories) %>%
  group_by(SampleID, Population) %>%
  summarise(
    n_wolf = sum(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# =====================================================
# Combine the four count columns
# =====================================================

class_counts_final <- hybrid_counts_wide %>%
  select(
    SampleID,
    Population,
    n_F1,
    n_BC1w,
    n_BC2w
  ) %>%
  full_join(
    wolf_counts,
    by = c("SampleID", "Population")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(n_F1, n_BC1w, n_BC2w, n_wolf),
      ~ replace_na(.x, 0L)
    )
  )

# =====================================================
# Join counts back to main table
# =====================================================

final_hybrid_table <- final_hybrid_table %>%
  left_join(
    class_counts_final,
    by = c("SampleID", "Population")
  )

# =====================================================
# 7️⃣ EXPORT
# =====================================================
write.xlsx(
  final_hybrid_table,
  "ParallelStructure_Results/3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids/R_results/3b_K6_Empirical_hybrids_and_problematic_wolves_all_seeds.xlsx",
  rowNames = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
names(categories_plot) <- c("pop","hy_verdict","count")

# fixed order for populations and hybrid classes


hy_levels <- c(
  "Dog", "BC2d","BC1d", "F1", "BC1w", "BC2w",
 "Balkan", "Italian", "German", "Romanian", "Mixed"
)

# apply factor levels for consistent order across all seeds
categories_plot$pop <- factor(categories_plot$pop, levels = pop_levels)
categories_plot$hy_verdict <- factor(categories_plot$hy_verdict, levels = hy_levels)

p_heatmap <- ggplot(categories_plot, aes(x = pop, y = hy_verdict, fill = count)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = count), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
  colours = c("white", "#deebf7", "#6baed6", "#2171b5"),
  values = scales::rescale(c(0, 3, max(categories_plot$count) * 0.5, max(categories_plot$count))))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 8),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")) +
  labs(title = paste("STRUCTURE assignment results vs. actual group – simulation replicate", seed),
       x = "Actual group",
       y = "STRUCTURE assignment results")

ggsave(file.path(paste0("ParallelStructure_Results/3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids/R_results/3b_K5_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids_", seed, "_heatmap.png")),
       p_heatmap, width = 11, height = 6, dpi = 300)


}
```

Statistics - Hybrid classification accuracy (K=5)
```{r}
# =====================================================
# SETTINGS
# =====================================================

seeds <- 1:10
base_dir <- "ParallelStructure_Results/3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids"

# cluster order per seed (manually tune if needed)
cluster_orders <- list(
  "1" = c("Dog",  "Germany", "Balkan", "Italy","Romania"),
  "2" = c("Dog",  "Germany", "Balkan", "Italy","Romania"),
  "3" = c("Dog",  "Romania", "Balkan", "Italy","Germany"),
  "4" = c("Dog",  "Germany", "Balkan", "Italy","Romania"),
  "5" = c("Dog",  "Germany", "Balkan", "Italy","Romania"),
  "6" = c("Dog",  "Germany", "Balkan", "Italy","Romania"),
  "7" = c("Dog",  "Germany", "Balkan", "Italy","Romania"),
  "8" = c("Dog",  "Germany", "Balkan", "Italy","Romania"),
  "9" = c("Dog",  "Germany", "Balkan", "Italy","Romania"),
  "10" = c("Dog",  "Germany", "Balkan", "Italy","Romania")
)

pop_levels <- c(
  "Dog","Sim-dog",
  "F1","BC1w","BC2w",
  "W-Slovenia","W-Croatia",
  "W-Middle_Balkan",
  "W-N.Macedonia","Sim-W-N.Macedonia",
  "W-Bulgaria","Sim-W-Bulgaria",
  "W-Italy","Sim-W-Italy",
  "W-Germany","Sim-W-Germany",
  "W-Romania","Sim-W-Romania"
)

wolf_classes <- c("Balkan","Italian","German","Romanian","Mixed")
expected_cols <- c("Dog","BC2d","BC1d","F1","BC1w","BC2w","Wolf")

# =====================================================
# 1️⃣ LOAD + CLASSIFY ALL SEEDS
# =====================================================

all_results <- list()

for (seed in seeds) {

  folder <- file.path(base_dir, paste0("3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids_", seed))
  input_file <- file.path(folder, paste0("3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids_", seed, ".txt"))
  pop_file   <- file.path(folder, paste0("3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids_", seed, "_POP.txt"))
  clumpp_file <- file.path(folder, "Clumpak_results/K=5/MajorCluster/CLUMPP.files/ClumppIndFile.output")

  struct_res <- read.table(clumpp_file)
  struct_input <- read.table(input_file, skip=1, as.is=TRUE)
  struct_legend <- read.table(pop_file, header=FALSE, sep=" ", as.is=TRUE)
  names(struct_legend) <- c("id","pop")

  structure_results <- cbind(struct_input[,1:2], struct_res[,6:10])
  structure_results$V2 <- as.character(structure_results$V2)

  names(structure_results) <- c("Sample","Pop", cluster_orders[[as.character(seed)]])
  structure_results$Pop <- as.character(structure_results$Pop)
  struct_legend$id <- as.character(struct_legend$id)

  structure_results <- left_join(structure_results, struct_legend,
                                 by = c("Pop" = "id"))

  structure_results$pop <- factor(structure_results$pop, levels = pop_levels)

  # =====================================================
  # THRESHOLDS (FROM CODE 4)
  # =====================================================

  thresholds_adj <- c(
    BC2d  = 0.94,
    BC1d  = 0.83,
    F1    = 0.64,
    BC1w  = 0.32,
    BC2w  = 0.12,
    Wolf  = 0.05
  )

  thresh_BC2d <- thresholds_adj["BC2d"]
  thresh_BC1d <- thresholds_adj["BC1d"]
  thresh_F1   <- thresholds_adj["F1"]
  thresh_BC1w  <- thresholds_adj["BC1w"]
  thresh_BC2w <- thresholds_adj["BC2w"]
  thresh_wolf <- thresholds_adj["Wolf"]

  # =====================================================
  # CLASSIFICATION
  # =====================================================

  classified <- structure_results %>%
    mutate(across(c(Dog,Balkan,Italy,Germany,Romania), as.numeric)) %>%
    mutate(
      hy_verdict = case_when(
        Dog >= thresh_BC2d ~ "Dog",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1d ~ "BC2d",
        Dog >= thresh_F1   ~ "BC1d",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1w  ~ "F1",
        Dog >= thresh_BC2w ~ "BC1w",
        Dog >= thresh_wolf ~ "BC2w",
        Balkan  > 0.7 ~ "Balkan",
        Italy   > 0.7 ~ "Italian",
        Germany > 0.7 ~ "German",
        Romania > 0.7 ~ "Romanian",
        TRUE ~ "Mixed"
      ),
      seed = seed
    ) %>%
    select(pop, hy_verdict, seed)

  all_results[[as.character(seed)]] <- classified
}

all_classifications <- bind_rows(all_results)

# =====================================================
# 2️⃣ CALCULATE % PER SEED
# =====================================================

seed_counts <- all_classifications %>%
  mutate(
    pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels),
    classified_group = ifelse(hy_verdict %in% wolf_classes, "Wolf", hy_verdict)
  ) %>%
  count(seed, pop, classified_group) %>%
  complete(seed, pop = pop_levels, classified_group = expected_cols, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  group_by(seed, pop) %>%
  mutate(percentage = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

# =====================================================
# 3️⃣ PER-SEED TABLES
# =====================================================

seed_tables <- seed_counts %>%
  select(seed, pop, classified_group, percentage) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group,
              values_from = percentage,
              values_fill = 0)

# =====================================================
# 4️⃣ MEAN + SD + SE + CI (FROM CODE 3)
# =====================================================

summary_stats <- seed_counts %>%
  group_by(pop, classified_group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(percentage),
    sd   = sd(percentage),
    n    = n(),
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    ci_lower = mean - qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se,
    ci_upper = mean + qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- mean only
mean_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group, values_from = mean, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop) %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols))

# --- mean ± SD
mean_sd_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, sd) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group, values_from = c(mean, sd))

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_sd_table[[cls]] <- sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f",
                                  mean_sd_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
                                  mean_sd_table[[paste0("sd_", cls)]])
}

mean_sd_table <- mean_sd_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)

# --- mean ± SE
mean_se_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, se) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group, values_from = c(mean, se))

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_se_table[[cls]] <- sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f",
                                  mean_se_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
                                  mean_se_table[[paste0("se_", cls)]])
}

mean_se_table <- mean_se_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)

# --- mean ± CI
mean_ci_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, ci_lower, ci_upper) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group,
              values_from = c(mean, ci_lower, ci_upper))

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_ci_table[[cls]] <- sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)",
                                  mean_ci_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
                                  mean_ci_table[[paste0("ci_lower_", cls)]],
                                  mean_ci_table[[paste0("ci_upper_", cls)]])
}

mean_ci_table <- mean_ci_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)

# =====================================================
# 5️⃣ EXPORT
# =====================================================

wb <- createWorkbook()

for (s in seeds) {
  seed_sheet <- seed_tables %>%
    filter(seed == s) %>%
    mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
    arrange(pop) %>%
    select(pop, all_of(expected_cols))

  addWorksheet(wb, paste0("Seed_", s))
  writeData(wb, paste0("Seed_", s), seed_sheet)
}

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_only")
writeData(wb, "Mean_only", mean_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_plus_SD")
writeData(wb, "Mean_plus_SD", mean_sd_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_plus_SE")
writeData(wb, "Mean_plus_SE", mean_se_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_plus_CI")
writeData(wb, "Mean_plus_CI", mean_ci_table)

saveWorkbook(
  wb,
  "ParallelStructure_Results/3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids/R_results/3b_K5_Hybrid_classification_accuracy_per_seed_1-10_SD_SE_CI.xlsx",
  overwrite = TRUE
)

```

Classification and Q_Dog value for empirical hybrids and problematic wolves (K=6)
```{r}
# =====================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# =====================================================
seeds <- 1:10
base_dir <- "ParallelStructure_Results/3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids"

# cluster order per seed (manually tune if needed)
cluster_orders <- list(
  "1" = c("Dog",  "Germany", "Balkan", "Italy","Romania"),
  "2" = c("Dog",  "Germany", "Balkan", "Italy","Romania"),
  "3" = c("Dog",  "Romania", "Balkan", "Italy","Germany"),
  "4" = c("Dog",  "Germany", "Balkan", "Italy","Romania"),
  "5" = c("Dog",  "Germany", "Balkan", "Italy","Romania"),
  "6" = c("Dog",  "Germany", "Balkan", "Italy","Romania"),
  "7" = c("Dog",  "Germany", "Balkan", "Italy","Romania"),
  "8" = c("Dog",  "Germany", "Balkan", "Italy","Romania"),
  "9" = c("Dog",  "Germany", "Balkan", "Italy","Romania"),
  "10" = c("Dog",  "Germany", "Balkan", "Italy","Romania")
)

hybrid_labels <- c("BC2d","BC1d","F1","BC1w","BC2w")

wolf_pops <- c(
    "W-Slovenia","W-Croatia","W-Middle_Balkan","W-N.Macedonia",
  "W-Bulgaria","W-Italy","W-Germany","W-Romania"
)

desired_order <- c(
  "Dog","Sim-dog",
  "F1","BC1w","BC2w",
  "W-Slovenia","W-Croatia",
  "W-Middle_Balkan",
  "W-N.Macedonia","Sim-W-N.Macedonia",
  "W-Bulgaria","Sim-W-Bulgaria",
  "W-Italy","Sim-W-Italy",
  "W-Germany","Sim-W-Germany",
  "W-Romania","Sim-W-Romania"
)

thresholds_adj <- c(
  BC2d  = 0.94,
  BC1d  = 0.83,
  F1    = 0.64,
  BC1w  = 0.32,
  BC2w  = 0.12,
  Wolf  = 0.05)

# =====================================================
# 1️⃣ LOAD + CLASSIFY ALL SEEDS
# =====================================================
all_results <- list()

for (seed in seeds) {

  folder <- file.path(base_dir, paste0("3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids_", seed))
  input_file  <- file.path(folder, paste0("3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids_", seed, ".txt"))
  pop_file    <- file.path(folder, paste0("3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids_", seed, "_POP.txt"))
  clumpp_file <- file.path(folder, "Clumpak_results/K=5/MajorCluster/CLUMPP.files/ClumppIndFile.output")

  struct_res    <- read.table(clumpp_file)
  struct_input  <- read.table(input_file, skip = 1, as.is = TRUE)
  struct_legend <- read.table(pop_file, header = FALSE, as.is = TRUE)
  names(struct_legend) <- c("id","pop")

  structure_results <- cbind(struct_input[,1:2], struct_res[,6:10])
  names(structure_results) <- c("Sample","Pop", cluster_orders[[as.character(seed)]])
  structure_results$Pop <- as.character(structure_results$Pop)
  struct_legend$id <- as.character(struct_legend$id)

  structure_results <- left_join(structure_results, struct_legend,
                                 by = c("Pop" = "id"))

  structure_results <- structure_results %>%
    mutate(across(c(Dog, Balkan, Italy, Germany, Romania), as.numeric)) %>%
    mutate(
      hy_verdict = case_when(
        Dog >= thresholds_adj["BC2d"] ~ "Dog",
        Dog >= thresholds_adj["BC1d"] ~ "BC2d",
        Dog >= thresholds_adj["F1"]   ~ "BC1d",
        Dog >= thresholds_adj["BC1w"]  ~ "F1",
        Dog >= thresholds_adj["BC2w"] ~ "BC1w",
        Dog >= thresholds_adj["Wolf"] ~ "BC2w",
        Balkan  > 0.7 ~ "Balkan",
        Italy     > 0.7 ~ "Italian",
        Germany   > 0.7 ~ "German",
        Romania   > 0.7 ~ "Romanian",
        TRUE ~ "Mixed"
      ),
      seed = seed
    ) %>%
    select(Sample, pop, Dog, hy_verdict, seed)

  all_results[[as.character(seed)]] <- structure_results
}

all_classifications <- bind_rows(all_results)

# =====================================================
# 2️⃣ EMPIRICAL ONLY + NO DOGS
# =====================================================
all_empirical <- all_classifications %>%
  filter(
    !grepl("^Sim-", pop),
    pop != "Dog"
  )

# =====================================================
# 3️⃣ SAMPLE SELECTION
# =====================================================
samples_of_interest <- all_empirical %>%
  mutate(is_hybrid = hy_verdict %in% hybrid_labels) %>%
  group_by(Sample, pop) %>%
  summarise(ever_hybrid = any(is_hybrid), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(
    (pop %in% wolf_pops & ever_hybrid) |
    !(pop %in% wolf_pops)
  )

# =====================================================
# 4️⃣ PIVOT: HYBRID CLASS
# =====================================================
verdict_wide <- all_empirical %>%
  semi_join(samples_of_interest, by = c("Sample","pop")) %>%
  select(Sample, pop, seed, hy_verdict) %>%
  mutate(seed = paste0("Seed", seed, "_class")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = seed, values_from = hy_verdict)

# =====================================================
# 5️⃣ PIVOT: qDog
# =====================================================
qdog_wide <- all_empirical %>%
  semi_join(samples_of_interest, by = c("Sample","pop")) %>%
  select(Sample, pop, seed, Dog) %>%
  mutate(seed = paste0("Seed", seed, "_qDog")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = seed, values_from = Dog)

# =====================================================
# 6️⃣ FINAL TABLE + ORDERING
# =====================================================
final_hybrid_table <- verdict_wide %>%
  left_join(qdog_wide, by = c("Sample","pop")) %>%
  rename(
    SampleID   = Sample,
    Population = pop
  ) %>%
  arrange(order(factor(Population, levels = desired_order)))

# =====================================================
# 6b COUNT CLASSIFICATIONS ACROSS SEEDS
# =====================================================

# Identify class columns
class_cols <- grep("_class$", names(final_hybrid_table), value = TRUE)

# Convert to long format
class_long <- final_hybrid_table %>%
  select(SampleID, Population, all_of(class_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(class_cols),
    names_to = "Seed",
    values_to = "Class"
  )

# Count classifications per sample
class_counts <- class_long %>%
  group_by(SampleID, Population, Class) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

# =====================================================
# Keep only the classifications of interest
# =====================================================

# Wolf categories to combine
wolf_categories <- c(
  "Balkan",
  "Italian",
  "German",
  "Romanian",
  "Mixed"
)

# Hybrid categories to keep separately
hybrid_count_categories <- c(
  "BC2w",
  "BC1w",
  "F1"
)

# =====================================================
# Create counts for BC2w, BC1w and F1
# =====================================================

hybrid_counts_wide <- class_counts %>%
  filter(Class %in% hybrid_count_categories) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Class,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0,
    names_prefix = "n_"
  )

# Make sure all three columns exist
for (x in paste0("n_", hybrid_count_categories)) {
  if (!x %in% names(hybrid_counts_wide)) {
    hybrid_counts_wide[[x]] <- 0L
  }
}

# =====================================================
# Create combined wolf count
# =====================================================

wolf_counts <- class_counts %>%
  filter(Class %in% wolf_categories) %>%
  group_by(SampleID, Population) %>%
  summarise(
    n_wolf = sum(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# =====================================================
# Combine the four count columns
# =====================================================

class_counts_final <- hybrid_counts_wide %>%
  select(
    SampleID,
    Population,
    n_F1,
    n_BC1w,
    n_BC2w
  ) %>%
  full_join(
    wolf_counts,
    by = c("SampleID", "Population")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(n_F1, n_BC1w, n_BC2w, n_wolf),
      ~ replace_na(.x, 0L)
    )
  )

# =====================================================
# Join counts back to main table
# =====================================================

final_hybrid_table <- final_hybrid_table %>%
  left_join(
    class_counts_final,
    by = c("SampleID", "Population")
  )

# =====================================================
# 7️⃣ EXPORT
# =====================================================
write.xlsx(
  final_hybrid_table,
  "ParallelStructure_Results/3b_Empirical_Simulation_data_no_hybrids/R_results/3b_K5_Empirical_hybrids_and_problematic_wolves_all_seeds.xlsx",
  rowNames = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
  structure_results$Pop <- as.character(structure_results$Pop)
struct_legend$id <- as.character(struct_legend$id)


structure_results <- left_join(structure_results, struct_legend, by = c("Pop" = "id"))

  # ------------------------------------------------
  # FORCE POP ORDER FOR LEGEND 
  # ------------------------------------------------
 structure_results$pop <- factor(
    structure_results$pop,
    levels = pop_levels
  )


  # --- compute reference means for available categories

  ref_means <- structure_results %>%
    filter(pop %in% c(
      "Dog","Sim-dog",
      "F1","Sim-F1_CRO","Sim-F1_BUL","Sim-F1_ITA","Sim-F1_GER","Sim-F1_ROM",
      "BC1w","Sim-BC1w_CRO","Sim-BC1w_BUL","Sim-BC1w_ITA","Sim-BC1w_GER","Sim-BC1w_ROM",
      "BC2w","Sim-BC2w_CRO","Sim-BC2w_BUL","Sim-BC2w_ITA","Sim-BC2w_GER","Sim-BC2w_ROM",
      "W-Slovenia","W-Croatia","W-Middle_Balkan",
      "W-N.Macedonia","Sim-W-N.Macedonia",
      "W-Bulgaria","Sim-W-Bulgaria",
      "W-Italy","Sim-W-Italy",
      "W-Germany","Sim-W-Germany",
      "W-Romania","Sim-W-Romania"
    )) %>%
    group_by(pop) %>%
    summarise(mean_qDog = mean(Dog, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  # ---- FIXED dog-side thresholds (no BC2d / BC1d data available)

  thresh_BC2d <- 0.94
  thresh_BC1d <- 0.83
  thresh_F1   <- 0.64

  # ---- Calculate wolf-side thresholds from data (same logic as Code 1)

  mean_F1   <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-F1", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC1w  <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC1w", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC2w <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC2w", ref_means$pop)])

  mean_wolf <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[
    ref_means$pop %in% c(
      "W-Slovenia","W-Croatia","W-Middle_Balkan",
      "W-N.Macedonia","W-Bulgaria",
      "W-Italy","W-Germany","W-Romania"
    )
  ])

  # midpoint thresholds (same formula as Code 1)

  thresh_BC1w  <- (mean_F1   + mean_BC1w)  / 2
  thresh_BC2w <- (mean_BC1w  + mean_BC2w) / 2
  thresh_wolf <- (mean_BC2w + mean_wolf) / 2

  # apply same minimum cutoffs as in Code 1

  thresholds_raw <- c(
    BC2d  = thresh_BC2d,
    BC1d  = thresh_BC1d,
    F1    = thresh_F1,
    BC1w   = thresh_BC1w,
    BC2w  = thresh_BC2w,
    Wolf  = thresh_wolf
  )

  thresholds_adj <- thresholds_raw %>%
    pmax(c(
      0.94,  # BC2d fixed
      0.83,  # BC1d fixed
      0.64,  # F1 fixed
      0.3,   # BC1w minimum
      0.1,   # BC2w minimum
      0.05   # Wolf minimum
    )) %>%
    round(3) %>%
    setNames(names(thresholds_raw))

  thresh_BC2d  <- thresholds_adj["BC2d"]
  thresh_BC1d  <- thresholds_adj["BC1d"]
  thresh_F1    <- thresholds_adj["F1"]
  thresh_BC1w   <- thresholds_adj["BC1w"]
  thresh_BC2w  <- thresholds_adj["BC2w"]
  thresh_wolf  <- thresholds_adj["Wolf"]


  # --- classify samples
structure_results_categories <- structure_results %>%
  mutate(across(c(Dog,N_Dinaric,S_Balkan ,Italy,Germany,Romania), as.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(
    hy_verdict = case_when(
      Dog >= thresh_BC2d        ~ "Dog",
      Dog >= thresh_BC1d        ~ "BC2d",
      Dog >= thresh_F1          ~ "BC1d",
      Dog >= thresh_BC1w        ~ "F1",
      Dog >= thresh_BC2w        ~ "BC1w",
      Dog >= thresh_wolf        ~ "BC2w",
        N_Dinaric  > 0.7 ~ "N_Dinaric",
        S_Balkan  > 0.7 ~ "S_Balkan",
        Italy     > 0.7 ~ "Italian",
        Germany   > 0.7 ~ "German",
        Romania   > 0.7 ~ "Romanian",
        TRUE ~ "Mixed"
  ))

  # ------------------------------------------
  # PLOT 1: DENSITY PLOT
  # ------------------------------------------
  thresholds_df <- data.frame(
  value = c(
    thresh_wolf,
    thresh_BC2w,
    thresh_BC1w,
    thresh_F1,
    thresh_BC1d,
    thresh_BC2d
  ),
  label = c(
    paste0("wolf < ", round(thresh_wolf, 3), " > BC2w"),
    paste0("BC2w < ", round(thresh_BC2w, 3), " > BC1w"),
    paste0("BC1w < ", round(thresh_BC1w, 3), " > F1"),
    paste0("F1 < ", round(thresh_F1, 3), " > BC1d"),
    paste0("BC1d < ", round(thresh_BC1d, 3), " > BC2d"),
    paste0("BC2d < ", round(thresh_BC2d, 3), " > dog")
  )
)
  p_density <- structure_results %>%
    filter(pop %in% names(color_map)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=Dog, fill=pop)) +
    geom_density(alpha=0.5, adjust=1) +
    geom_vline(data=thresholds_df, aes(xintercept=value),
               linetype="dashed", color="red", linewidth=0.6) +
    geom_text(data=thresholds_df, aes(x=value, y=45, label=label),
              inherit.aes=FALSE, angle=90, vjust=-0.4, size=3, color="red") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,50)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=color_map) +
    theme(legend.position="right", legend.title=element_blank()) +
    labs(title=paste("Distribution of dog Q-values – simulation replicate", seed),
         subtitle="Dashed red lines show hybrid thresholds",
         x="Q_Dog value", y="Density (capped at 50)")

  ggsave(file.path(paste0("ParallelStructure_Results/4a_Simulation_data_wolves_hybrids/R_results/4a_K6_Simulation_data_wolves_hybrids_",seed,"_density_plot.png")),
         p_density, width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

# ------------------------------------------
# PLOT 2: HEATMAP OF POP VS. HYBRID CLASS
# ------------------------------------------
table_data_plot <- table(structure_results_categories$pop,
                         structure_results_categories$hy_verdict)
categories_plot <- as.data.frame(table_data_plot)
names(categories_plot) <- c("pop","hy_verdict","count")

# fixed order for populations and hybrid classes


hy_levels <- c(
  "Dog", "BC2d","BC1d", "F1", "BC1w", "BC2w",
 "N_Dinaric", "S_Balkan", "Italian", "German", "Romanian", "Mixed"
)

# apply factor levels for consistent order across all seeds
categories_plot$pop <- factor(categories_plot$pop, levels = pop_levels)
categories_plot$hy_verdict <- factor(categories_plot$hy_verdict, levels = hy_levels)

p_heatmap <- ggplot(categories_plot, aes(x = pop, y = hy_verdict, fill = count)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = count), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
  colours = c("white", "#deebf7", "#6baed6", "#2171b5"),
  values = scales::rescale(c(0, 3, max(categories_plot$count) * 0.5, max(categories_plot$count))))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 8),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")) +
  labs(title = paste("STRUCTURE assignment results vs. actual group – simulation replicate", seed),
       x = "Actual group",
       y = "STRUCTURE assignment results")

ggsave(file.path(paste0("ParallelStructure_Results/4a_Simulation_data_wolves_hybrids/R_results/4a_K6_Simulation_data_wolves_hybrids_", seed, "_heatmap.png")),
       p_heatmap, width = 11, height = 6, dpi = 300)


}
```

Statistics - Hybrid classification accuracy (K=6)
```{r}

# =====================================================
# SETTINGS
# =====================================================

seeds <- 1:10
base_dir <- "ParallelStructure_Results/4a_Simulation_data_wolves_hybrids"

# cluster order per seed (manually tune if needed)
cluster_orders <- list(
  "1" = c("Dog",  "Germany", "N_Dinaric", "Italy","Romania", "S_Balkan"),
  "2" = c("Dog",  "Italy", "Germany", "S_Balkan","Romania", "N_Dinaric"),
  "3" = c("Dog",  "N_Dinaric", "Germany", "Italy","Romania", "S_Balkan"),
  "4" = c("Dog",  "Italy", "Germany", "Romania","N_Dinaric", "S_Balkan"),
  "5" = c("Romania",  "Italy", "Germany", "N_Dinaric","Dog", "S_Balkan"),
  "6" = c("Romania",  "Italy", "N_Dinaric", "Germany","Dog", "S_Balkan"),  
  "7" = c("Romania",  "Germany", "N_Dinaric", "Italy","Dog", "S_Balkan"),
  "8" = c("Dog",  "Germany", "N_Dinaric", "Italy","Romania", "S_Balkan"),
  "9" = c("Dog",  "Germany", "N_Dinaric", "Italy","Romania", "S_Balkan"),
  "10" = c("Dog",  "Germany", "S_Balkan", "Italy","Romania", "N_Dinaric")
)

pop_levels <- c(
  "Dog","Sim-dog",
  "F1","Sim-F1_CRO","Sim-F1_BUL","Sim-F1_ITA","Sim-F1_GER","Sim-F1_ROM",
  "BC1w","Sim-BC1w_CRO","Sim-BC1w_BUL","Sim-BC1w_ITA","Sim-BC1w_GER","Sim-BC1w_ROM",
  "BC2w","Sim-BC2w_CRO","Sim-BC2w_BUL","Sim-BC2w_ITA","Sim-BC2w_GER","Sim-BC2w_ROM",
  "W-Slovenia","W-Croatia","W-Middle_Balkan",
  "W-N.Macedonia","Sim-W-N.Macedonia",
  "W-Bulgaria","Sim-W-Bulgaria",
  "W-Italy","Sim-W-Italy",
  "W-Germany","Sim-W-Germany",
  "W-Romania","Sim-W-Romania"
)

wolf_classes <- c("N_Dinaric","S_Balkan","Italian","German","Romanian","Mixed")
expected_cols <- c("Dog","BC2d","BC1d","F1","BC1w","BC2w","Wolf")

# =====================================================
# 1️⃣ LOAD + CLASSIFY ALL SEEDS
# =====================================================

all_results <- list()

for (seed in seeds) {

  folder <- file.path(base_dir, paste0("4a_Simulation_data_wolves_hybrids_", seed))
  input_file  <- file.path(folder, paste0("4a_Simulation_data_wolves_hybrids_", seed, ".txt"))
  pop_file    <- file.path(folder, paste0("4a_Simulation_data_wolves_hybrids_", seed, "_POP.txt"))
  clumpp_file <- file.path(folder, "Clumpak_results/K=6/MajorCluster/CLUMPP.files/ClumppIndFile.output")

  struct_res    <- read.table(clumpp_file)
  struct_input  <- read.table(input_file, skip = 1, as.is = TRUE)
  struct_legend <- read.table(pop_file, header = FALSE, sep = " ", as.is = TRUE)
  names(struct_legend) <- c("id","pop")

  structure_results <- cbind(struct_input[,1:2], struct_res[,6:11])
  names(structure_results) <- c("Sample","Pop", cluster_orders[[as.character(seed)]])
  structure_results$Pop <- as.character(structure_results$Pop)
  struct_legend$id <- as.character(struct_legend$id)

  structure_results <- left_join(structure_results, struct_legend,
                                by = c("Pop" = "id"))

  structure_results$pop <- factor(structure_results$pop, levels = pop_levels)

  # ----------------------------
  # THRESHOLDS (from Code 2)
  # ----------------------------
  ref_means <- structure_results %>%
    group_by(pop) %>%
    summarise(mean_qDog = mean(as.numeric(Dog), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  thresh_BC2d <- 0.94
  thresh_BC1d <- 0.83
  thresh_F1   <- 0.64

  mean_F1   <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-F1", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC1w  <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC1w", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC2w <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC2w", ref_means$pop)])

  mean_wolf <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[
    ref_means$pop %in% c("W-Slovenia","W-Croatia","W-Middle_Balkan",
                         "W-N.Macedonia","W-Bulgaria",
                         "W-Italy","W-Germany","W-Romania")
  ])

  thresh_BC1w  <- (mean_F1 + mean_BC1w) / 2
  thresh_BC2w <- (mean_BC1w + mean_BC2w) / 2
  thresh_wolf <- (mean_BC2w + mean_wolf) / 2

  # ----------------------------
  # CLASSIFICATION
  # ----------------------------
  classified <- structure_results %>%
    mutate(across(c(Dog,N_Dinaric,S_Balkan,Italy,Germany,Romania), as.numeric)) %>%
    mutate(
      hy_verdict = case_when(
        Dog >= thresh_BC2d ~ "Dog",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1d ~ "BC2d",
        Dog >= thresh_F1   ~ "BC1d",
        Dog >= thresh_BC1w  ~ "F1",
        Dog >= thresh_BC2w ~ "BC1w",
        Dog >= thresh_wolf ~ "BC2w",
        N_Dinaric > 0.7 ~ "N_Dinaric",
        S_Balkan  > 0.7 ~ "S_Balkan",
        Italy     > 0.7 ~ "Italian",
        Germany   > 0.7 ~ "German",
        Romania   > 0.7 ~ "Romanian",
        TRUE ~ "Mixed"
      ),
      seed = seed
    ) %>%
    select(pop, hy_verdict, seed)

  all_results[[as.character(seed)]] <- classified
}

all_classifications <- bind_rows(all_results)

# =====================================================
# 2️⃣ CALCULATE % PER SEED
# =====================================================

seed_counts <- all_classifications %>%
  mutate(
    pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels),
    classified_group = ifelse(hy_verdict %in% wolf_classes, "Wolf", hy_verdict)
  ) %>%
  count(seed, pop, classified_group) %>%
  complete(seed, pop = pop_levels, classified_group = expected_cols, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  group_by(seed, pop) %>%
  mutate(percentage = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

# =====================================================
# 3️⃣ PER-SEED TABLES
# =====================================================

seed_tables <- seed_counts %>%
  select(seed, pop, classified_group, percentage) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group,
              values_from = percentage,
              values_fill = 0)

# =====================================================
# 4️⃣ MEAN + SE + CI (t-based)
# =====================================================

summary_stats <- seed_counts %>%
  group_by(pop, classified_group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(percentage),
    sd   = sd(percentage),
    n    = n(),
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    ci_lower = mean - qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se,
    ci_upper = mean + qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- mean only
mean_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group,
              values_from = mean,
              values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop) %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols))

# --- mean ± SD
mean_sd_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, sd) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = classified_group,
    values_from = c(mean, sd)
  )

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_sd_table[[cls]] <- sprintf(
    "%.2f ± %.2f",
    mean_sd_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
    mean_sd_table[[paste0("sd_", cls)]]
  )
}

mean_sd_table <- mean_sd_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)

# --- mean ± SE
mean_se_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, se) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group,
              values_from = c(mean, se))

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_se_table[[cls]] <- sprintf(
    "%.2f ± %.2f",
    mean_se_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
    mean_se_table[[paste0("se_", cls)]]
  )
}

mean_se_table <- mean_se_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)

# --- mean ± CI
mean_ci_table <- summary_stats %>%
  select(pop, classified_group, mean, ci_lower, ci_upper) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = classified_group,
              values_from = c(mean, ci_lower, ci_upper))

for (cls in expected_cols) {
  mean_ci_table[[cls]] <- sprintf(
    "%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)",
    mean_ci_table[[paste0("mean_", cls)]],
    mean_ci_table[[paste0("ci_lower_", cls)]],
    mean_ci_table[[paste0("ci_upper_", cls)]]
  )
}

mean_ci_table <- mean_ci_table %>%
  select(pop, all_of(expected_cols)) %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
  arrange(pop)

# =====================================================
# 5️⃣ EXPORT
# =====================================================

wb <- createWorkbook()

for (s in seeds) {
  seed_sheet <- seed_tables %>%
    filter(seed == s) %>%
    mutate(pop = factor(pop, levels = pop_levels)) %>%
    arrange(pop) %>%
    select(pop, all_of(expected_cols))
  
  addWorksheet(wb, paste0("Seed_", s))
  writeData(wb, paste0("Seed_", s), seed_sheet)
}

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_only")
writeData(wb, "Mean_only", mean_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_plus_SD")
writeData(wb, "Mean_plus_SD", mean_sd_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_plus_SE")
writeData(wb, "Mean_plus_SE", mean_se_table)

addWorksheet(wb, "Mean_plus_CI")
writeData(wb, "Mean_plus_CI", mean_ci_table)

saveWorkbook(
  wb,
  "ParallelStructure_Results/4a_Simulation_data_wolves_hybrids/R_results/4a_K6_Hybrid_classification_accuracy_SD_SE_CI.xlsx",
  overwrite = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
for (seed in seeds) {

  folder <- file.path(base_dir, paste0("4a_Simulation_data_wolves_hybrids_", seed))
  input_file <- file.path(folder, paste0("4a_Simulation_data_wolves_hybrids_", seed, ".txt"))
  pop_file   <- file.path(folder, paste0("4a_Simulation_data_wolves_hybrids_", seed, "_POP.txt"))
  clumpp_file <- file.path(folder, "Clumpak_results/K=6/MajorCluster/CLUMPP.files/ClumppIndFile.output")
  

  struct_res    <- read.table(clumpp_file)
  struct_input  <- read.table(input_file, skip = 1, as.is = TRUE)
  struct_legend <- read.table(pop_file, header = FALSE, as.is = TRUE)
  names(struct_legend) <- c("id","pop")

  structure_results <- cbind(struct_input[,1:2], struct_res[,6:11])
  names(structure_results) <- c("Sample","Pop", cluster_orders[[as.character(seed)]])
  structure_results$Pop <- as.character(structure_results$Pop)
  struct_legend$id <- as.character(struct_legend$id)

  structure_results <- left_join(structure_results, struct_legend,
                                 by = c("Pop" = "id"))

  structure_results <- structure_results %>%
    mutate(across(c(Dog, N_Dinaric, S_Balkan, Italy, Germany, Romania), as.numeric)) %>%
    mutate(
      hy_verdict = case_when(
      Dog >= thresh_BC2d        ~ "Dog",
      Dog >= thresh_BC1d        ~ "BC2d",
      Dog >= thresh_F1          ~ "BC1d",
      Dog >= thresh_BC1w        ~ "F1",
      Dog >= thresh_BC2w        ~ "BC1w",
      Dog >= thresh_wolf        ~ "BC2w",
        N_Dinaric  > 0.7 ~ "N_Dinaric",
        S_Balkan  > 0.7 ~ "S_Balkan",
        Italy     > 0.7 ~ "Italian",
        Germany   > 0.7 ~ "German",
        Romania   > 0.7 ~ "Romanian",
        TRUE ~ "Mixed"
      ),
      seed = seed
    ) %>%
    select(Sample, pop, Dog, hy_verdict, seed)

  all_results[[as.character(seed)]] <- structure_results
}

all_classifications <- bind_rows(all_results)

# =====================================================
# 2️⃣ EMPIRICAL ONLY + NO DOGS
# =====================================================
all_empirical <- all_classifications %>%
  filter(
    !grepl("^Sim-", pop),
    pop != "Dog"
  )

# =====================================================
# 3️⃣ SAMPLE SELECTION
# =====================================================
samples_of_interest <- all_empirical %>%
  mutate(is_hybrid = hy_verdict %in% hybrid_labels) %>%
  group_by(Sample, pop) %>%
  summarise(ever_hybrid = any(is_hybrid), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(
    (pop %in% wolf_pops & ever_hybrid) |
    !(pop %in% wolf_pops)
  )

# =====================================================
# 4️⃣ PIVOT: HYBRID CLASS
# =====================================================
verdict_wide <- all_empirical %>%
  semi_join(samples_of_interest, by = c("Sample","pop")) %>%
  select(Sample, pop, seed, hy_verdict) %>%
  mutate(seed = paste0("Seed", seed, "_class")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = seed, values_from = hy_verdict)

# =====================================================
# 5️⃣ PIVOT: qDog
# =====================================================
qdog_wide <- all_empirical %>%
  semi_join(samples_of_interest, by = c("Sample","pop")) %>%
  select(Sample, pop, seed, Dog) %>%
  mutate(seed = paste0("Seed", seed, "_qDog")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = seed, values_from = Dog)

# =====================================================
# 6️⃣ FINAL TABLE + ORDERING
# =====================================================
final_hybrid_table <- verdict_wide %>%
  left_join(qdog_wide, by = c("Sample","pop")) %>%
  rename(
    SampleID   = Sample,
    Population = pop
  ) %>%
  arrange(order(factor(Population, levels = desired_order)))


# =====================================================
# 6b COUNT CLASSIFICATIONS ACROSS SEEDS
# =====================================================

# Identify class columns
class_cols <- grep("_class$", names(final_hybrid_table), value = TRUE)

# Convert to long format
class_long <- final_hybrid_table %>%
  select(SampleID, Population, all_of(class_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(class_cols),
    names_to = "Seed",
    values_to = "Class"
  )

# Count classifications per sample
class_counts <- class_long %>%
  group_by(SampleID, Population, Class) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

# =====================================================
# Keep only the classifications of interest
# =====================================================

# Wolf categories to combine
wolf_categories <- c(
  "N_Dinaric",
  "S_Balkan",
  "Italian",
  "German",
  "Romanian",
  "Mixed"
)

# Hybrid categories to keep separately
hybrid_count_categories <- c(
  "BC2w",
  "BC1w",
  "F1"
)

# =====================================================
# Create counts for BC2w, BC1w and F1
# =====================================================

hybrid_counts_wide <- class_counts %>%
  filter(Class %in% hybrid_count_categories) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Class,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0,
    names_prefix = "n_"
  )

# Make sure all three columns exist
for (x in paste0("n_", hybrid_count_categories)) {
  if (!x %in% names(hybrid_counts_wide)) {
    hybrid_counts_wide[[x]] <- 0L
  }
}

# =====================================================
# Create combined wolf count
# =====================================================

wolf_counts <- class_counts %>%
  filter(Class %in% wolf_categories) %>%
  group_by(SampleID, Population) %>%
  summarise(
    n_wolf = sum(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# =====================================================
# Combine the four count columns
# =====================================================

class_counts_final <- hybrid_counts_wide %>%
  select(
    SampleID,
    Population,
    n_F1,
    n_BC1w,
    n_BC2w
  ) %>%
  full_join(
    wolf_counts,
    by = c("SampleID", "Population")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(n_F1, n_BC1w, n_BC2w, n_wolf),
      ~ replace_na(.x, 0L)
    )
  )

# =====================================================
# Join counts back to main table
# =====================================================

final_hybrid_table <- final_hybrid_table %>%
  left_join(
    class_counts_final,
    by = c("SampleID", "Population")
  )

# =====================================================
# 7️⃣ EXPORT
# =====================================================
write.xlsx(
  final_hybrid_table,
  "ParallelStructure_Results/4a_Simulation_data_wolves_hybrids/R_results/4a_K6_Empirical_hybrids_and_problematic_wolves_all_seeds.xlsx",
  rowNames = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------
# CONFIGURATION

seeds <- 1:10

# colour palette for all plots

# ------------------------------------------
# LOOP THROUGH SEEDS
# ------------------------------------------
for (seed in seeds) {
  cat("\n=== Seed", seed, "===\n")

  folder <- file.path(base_dir, paste0("4a_Simulation_data_wolves_hybrids_", seed))
  input_file <- file.path(folder, paste0("4a_Simulation_data_wolves_hybrids_", seed, ".txt"))
  pop_file   <- file.path(folder, paste0("4a_Simulation_data_wolves_hybrids_", seed, "_POP.txt"))
  clumpp_file <- file.path(folder, "Clumpak_results/K=5/MajorCluster/CLUMPP.files/ClumppIndFile.output")
  
  
  # --- load data
  struct_res <- read.table(clumpp_file)
  struct_input <- read.table(input_file, skip=1, as.is=TRUE)
  struct_legend <- read.table(pop_file, header=FALSE, sep=" ", as.is=TRUE)
  names(struct_legend) <- c("id","pop")

  structure_results <- cbind(struct_input[,1:2], struct_res[,6:10])
  structure_results$V2 <- as.character(structure_results$V2)
  names(structure_results) <- c("Sample","Pop", cluster_orders[[as.character(seed)]])
  structure_results$Pop <- as.character(structure_results$Pop)
struct_legend$id <- as.character(struct_legend$id)


structure_results <- left_join(structure_results, struct_legend, by = c("Pop" = "id"))

  # ------------------------------------------------
  # FORCE POP ORDER FOR LEGEND 
  # ------------------------------------------------
 structure_results$pop <- factor(
    structure_results$pop,
    levels = pop_levels
  )

 # --- compute reference means for available categories

  ref_means <- structure_results %>%
    filter(pop %in% c(
      "Dog","Sim-dog",
      "F1","Sim-F1_CRO","Sim-F1_BUL","Sim-F1_ITA","Sim-F1_GER","Sim-F1_ROM",
      "BC1w","Sim-BC1w_CRO","Sim-BC1w_BUL","Sim-BC1w_ITA","Sim-BC1w_GER","Sim-BC1w_ROM",
      "BC2w","Sim-BC2w_CRO","Sim-BC2w_BUL","Sim-BC2w_ITA","Sim-BC2w_GER","Sim-BC2w_ROM",
      "W-Slovenia","W-Croatia","W-Middle_Balkan",
      "W-N.Macedonia","Sim-W-N.Macedonia",
      "W-Bulgaria","Sim-W-Bulgaria",
      "W-Italy","Sim-W-Italy",
      "W-Germany","Sim-W-Germany",
      "W-Romania","Sim-W-Romania"
    )) %>%
    group_by(pop) %>%
    summarise(mean_qDog = mean(Dog, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  # ---- FIXED dog-side thresholds (no BC2d / BC1d data available)

  thresh_BC2d <- 0.94
  thresh_BC1d <- 0.83
  thresh_F1   <- 0.64

  # ---- Calculate wolf-side thresholds from data (same logic as Code 1)

  mean_F1   <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-F1", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC1w  <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC1w", ref_means$pop)])
  mean_BC2w <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[grepl("Sim-BC2w", ref_means$pop)])

  mean_wolf <- mean(ref_means$mean_qDog[
    ref_means$pop %in% c(
      "W-Slovenia","W-Croatia","W-Middle_Balkan",
      "W-N.Macedonia","W-Bulgaria",
      "W-Italy","W-Germany","W-Romania"
    )
  ])

  # midpoint thresholds (same formula as Code 1)

  thresh_BC1w  <- (mean_F1   + mean_BC1w)  / 2
  thresh_BC2w <- (mean_BC1w  + mean_BC2w) / 2
  thresh_wolf <- (mean_BC2w + mean_wolf) / 2

  # apply same minimum cutoffs as in Code 1

  thresholds_raw <- c(
    BC2d  = thresh_BC2d,
    BC1d  = thresh_BC1d,
    F1    = thresh_F1,
    BC1w   = thresh_BC1w,
    BC2w  = thresh_BC2w,
    Wolf  = thresh_wolf
  )

  thresholds_adj <- thresholds_raw %>%
    pmax(c(
      0.94,  # BC2d fixed
      0.83,  # BC1d fixed
      0.64,  # F1 fixed
      0.3,   # BC1w minimum
      0.1,   # BC2w minimum
      0.05   # Wolf minimum
    )) %>%
    round(3) %>%
    setNames(names(thresholds_raw))

  thresh_BC2d  <- thresholds_adj["BC2d"]
  thresh_BC1d  <- thresholds_adj["BC1d"]
  thresh_F1    <- thresholds_adj["F1"]
  thresh_BC1w   <- thresholds_adj["BC1w"]
  thresh_BC2w  <- thresholds_adj["BC2w"]
  thresh_wolf  <- thresholds_adj["Wolf"]


  # --- classify samples
structure_results_categories <- structure_results %>%
  mutate(across(c(Dog,Balkan ,Italy,Germany,Romania), as.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(
    hy_verdict = case_when(
      Dog >= thresh_BC2d        ~ "Dog",
      Dog >= thresh_BC1d        ~ "BC2d",
      Dog >= thresh_F1          ~ "BC1d",
      Dog >= thresh_BC1w        ~ "F1",
      Dog >= thresh_BC2w        ~ "BC1w",
      Dog >= thresh_wolf        ~ "BC2w",
        Balkan  > 0.7 ~ "Balkan",
        Italy     > 0.7 ~ "Italian",
        Germany   > 0.7 ~ "German",
        Romania   > 0.7 ~ "Romanian",
        TRUE ~ "Mixed"
  ))

  # ------------------------------------------
  # PLOT 1: DENSITY PLOT
  # ------------------------------------------
  thresholds_df <- data.frame(
  value = c(
    thresh_wolf,
    thresh_BC2w,
    thresh_BC1w,
    thresh_F1,
    thresh_BC1d,
    thresh_BC2d
  ),
  label = c(
    paste0("wolf < ", round(thresh_wolf, 3), " > BC2w"),
    paste0("BC2w < ", round(thresh_BC2w, 3), " > BC1w"),
    paste0("BC1w < ", round(thresh_BC1w, 3), " > F1"),
    paste0("F1 < ", round(thresh_F1, 3), " > BC1d"),
    paste0("BC1d < ", round(thresh_BC1d, 3), " > BC2d"),
    paste0("BC2d < ", round(thresh_BC2d, 3), " > dog")
  )
)
  p_density <- structure_results %>%
    filter(pop %in% names(color_map)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=Dog, fill=pop)) +
    geom_density(alpha=0.5, adjust=1) +
    geom_vline(data=thresholds_df, aes(xintercept=value),
               linetype="dashed", color="red", linewidth=0.6) +
    geom_text(data=thresholds_df, aes(x=value, y=45, label=label),
              inherit.aes=FALSE, angle=90, vjust=-0.4, size=3, color="red") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,50)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=color_map) +
    theme(legend.position="right", legend.title=element_blank()) +
    labs(title=paste("Distribution of dog Q-values – simulation replicate", seed),
         subtitle="Dashed red lines show hybrid thresholds",
         x="Q_Dog value", y="Density (capped at 50)")

  ggsave(file.path(paste0("ParallelStructure_Results/4a_Simulation_data_wolves_hybrids/R_results/4a_K5_Simulation_data_wolves_hybrids_",seed,"_density_plot.png")),
         p_density, width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

# ------------------------------------------
# PLOT 2: HEATMAP OF POP VS. HYBRID CLASS
# ------------------------------------------
table_data_plot <- table(structure_results_categories$pop,
                         structure_results_categories$hy_verdict)
categories_plot <- as.data.frame(table_data_plot)
names(categories_plot) <- c("pop","hy_verdict","count")

# fixed order for populations and hybrid classes


hy_levels <- c(
  "Dog", "BC2d","BC1d", "F1", "BC1w", "BC2w",
 "Balkan", "Italian", "German", "Romanian", "Mixed"
)

# apply factor levels for consistent order across all seeds
categories_plot$pop <- factor(categories_plot$pop, levels = pop_levels)
categories_plot$hy_verdict <- factor(categories_plot$hy_verdict, levels = hy_levels)

p_heatmap <- ggplot(categories_plot, aes(x = pop, y = hy_verdict, fill = count)) +

        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),

       x = "Actual group",
       y = "STRUCTURE assignment results")

ggsave(file.path(paste0("ParallelStructure_Results/4a_Simulation_data_wolves_hybrids/R_results/4a_K5_Simulation_data_wolves_hybrids_", seed, "_heatmap.png")),
```
